jobs.title: Project Manager IV
jobs.description:
What You'll Do

We are looking for a driven and experienced Project Manager to join our team to lead complex marketing and technology projects which have a direct impact on our business performance. You will lead the delivery of critical initiatives, develop the overall detailed delivery plan, oversee the development and implementation of identified initiatives tied to overall company and business unit strategy.

Here are few examples of the kinds of things you’ll do:

Lead critical projects to build foundational value and to bring new growth capabilities
Lead cross-functional teams in the planning and execution of process improvement/transformative projects to deliver intended results and develop close working relationships with cross-functional partners.
Provide subject matter expertise on project and change management efforts.
Develop requirements documentation and all other project related documentation including charters, RACI, implementation plan, communication plan, metric measurement plan, etc.
Determine key project milestones, timelines, resources, deliverables, dependencies, issues, risks, and outcomes.
Ensure project status reports and information roll-up into a Portfolio view accurately.
Ensure solutions conform to user requirements and client's objectives.
Work closely with IT partners and contribute to their agile ceremonies with prioritization of epics and user stories. Along with planning guidance, lead with close monitoring for the planned delivery of every sprint cycle.
Use and improve various methodologies, including project management process, change management concepts, and business process improvement methods.
Keep current as to new developments, best practices, industry trends, and new innovations.

Operating at the intersection of financial services and technology, Principal builds financial tools that help our customers live better lives. We take pride in being a purpose-led firm, motivated by our mission to make financial security accessible to all. Our mission, integrity, and customer focus have made us a trusted leader for more than 140 years!

Who You Are

Bachelor's degree or equivalent
6+ years project, program, or initiative management experience
Experience supporting marketing projects and initiatives highly preferred
Strong analytical, strategic, and tactical capabilities including knowledge of PC and project planning oriented software (i.e., Jira)
Must have excellent planning/organizational, problem-solving, influencing, presentation, listening, and oral and written communication skills
Excellent leadership skills required with the ability to build relationships, along with time management and decision-making skills
Experience working in a financial services industry preferred
Experience delivering in an agile/product environment

Salary Range Information

Salary ranges below reflect targeted base salaries. Non-sales positions have the opportunity to participate in a bonus program. Sales positions are eligible for sales incentives, and in some instances a bonus plan, whereby total compensation may far exceed base salary depending on individual performance. Actual compensation for all roles will be based upon geographic location, work experience, education, licensure requirements and/or skill level and will be finalized at the time of offer.

Salary Range (Non-Exempt expressed as hourly; Exempt expressed as yearly)

$104400 - $165000 / year

Salary Details

The following locations are examples of market-specific salary ranges across different geographies.

Grand Island, NE / Wichita, KS: $104,400 - $140,400 / year
Des Moines, IA / Tampa, FL: $110,200 - $148,200 / year
Charlotte, NC / Dallas, TX: $116,000 - $156,000/ year
Chicago, IL / Denver, CO / Minneapolis, MN: $127,600 - $165,000 / year
Los Angeles, CA / New York City, NY: $139,200 - $165,000 / year

Time Off Program

Flexible Time Off (FTO) is provided to salaried (exempt) employees and provides the opportunity to take time away from the office with pay for vacation, personal or short-term illness. Employees don’t accrue a bank of time off under FTO and there is no set number of days provided.

Pension Eligible

Yes

Work Authorization/Sponsorship

At this time, we're not considering applicants that need any type of immigration sponsorship (additional work authorization or permanent work authorization) now or in the future to work in the United States. This includes, but IS NOT LIMITED TO: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, L-1, J-1, etc. For additional information around work authorization needs please use the following links.

Nonimmigrant Workers and Green Card for Employment-Based Immigrants

For Principal Asset Management positions, you’ll need to follow an Investment Code of Ethics related to personal and business conduct as well as personal trading activities for you and members of your household. These same requirements may also apply to other positions across the organization.

At Principal, we value connecting on both a personal and professional level. Together, we’re imagining a more purpose-led future for financial services – and that starts with you. Our success depends on the unique experiences, backgrounds, and talents of our employees. And we support our employees the same way we support our customers: with comprehensive, competitive benefit offerings crafted to protect their physical, financial, and social well-being. jobs.title: Associate Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job Purpose

The Associate Project Manager is an integral part of our client-facing Project Management team. They will play a key role in ensuring correct and efficient running of localization projects. They will be responsible for delivering against project budget, timelines and quality requirements, and act as point of contact with client stakeholders for day-to-day operational matters. As part of the Project Management team, the Associate Project Manager will support the full end-to-end project lifecycle, with help and oversight from senior project managers. Previous experience in project management, an acute sense of responsibility and excellent client-facing skills are essential for this role.

About Transform

At RWS, we enable the world’s largest enterprises to communicate with global audiences through cutting-edge language technology, AI-driven solutions, and expert services. Our RWS Transform division empowers organizations to accelerate digital transformation, scale global content, and unlock growth in every market.

Job Overview

Project Management Execution: Manages standard translation projects, including scheduling, resource coordination, quotes, budgets and workflow execution. Handles essential admin tasks and identifies risks to ensure smooth delivery.
Leadership & Collaboration: Serves as day-to-day client contact (with senior PM support), provides updates, and collaborates with cross-functional teams. Supports account initiatives, process improvements, forecasting and team knowledge sharing.
Operational Excellence: Delivers projects on time, on budget and to quality expectations. Produces reporting and post-mortems, ensures resources are briefed and equipped, and supports compliance and CAPA requirements.
People Development: Works under APGM supervision while exercising independent judgment. Takes responsibility for professional growth and contributes to team knowledge exchange.

Skills & Experience

1–3 years of project coordination experience (localization or related to Life Sciences), plus 1 year of customer service/account management.
Dependable team member with growing understanding of translation project workflows and standard operational practices.
Clear and professional communication, strong organization and planning, ability to work under pressure, provide guidance to others, resolve issues efficiently, and maintain high quality and attention to detail.
Proactive, client-focused, collaborative and reliable, with the ability to support junior colleagues when needed.
Desired: Fluency in an additional language, familiarity with CAT tools and custom workflows, and a relevant four-year degree or equivalent.

Life at RWS
- If
you like the idea of working with smart people who are passionate about growing the value of ideas, data and content by making sure organizations are understood, then you’ll love life at RWS.
Our purpose is to unlock global understanding. This means our work fundamentally recognizes the value of every language and culture. So, we celebrate difference, we are inclusive and believe that diversity makes us strong. We want every employee to grow as an individual and excel in their career.
In return, we expect all our people to live by the values that unite us: to partner
, putting clients fist and winning together , to pioneer
, innovating fearlessly and leading with vision and courage, to progress
, aiming high and growing through actions and to deliver
, owning the outcome and building trust with our colleagues and clients.

RWS embraces DEI and
promotes equal opportunity, we are an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. RWS is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at RWS are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, religion, nationality, ethnicity, sex, age, disability, or sexual orientation. RWS will not tolerate discrimination based on any of these characteristics.

RWS Values

Get the 3Ps right – Partner, Pioneer, Progress – and we´ll Deliver together as RWS.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Technology Transfer - Pharma
jobs.description:
Akkodis è un leader globale nel mercato dell'ingegneria e della ricerca e sviluppo che mira ad accelerare l'innovazione e la trasformazione digitale utilizzando la forza dei connected data. Con la passione per la tecnologia e il talento, il gruppo composto da 50.000 ingegneri ed esperti digitali offre una profonda esperienza intersettoriale in 30 paesi tra Nord America, EMEA e APAC.

La divisione Lifesciences di Akkodis è leader a livello italiano nell’ambito della consulenza ingegneristica, convalida e servizi GMP per le aziende del comparto farmaceutico, chimico e sanitario. Costituita da consulenti specializzati di elevato livello tecnico e provata esperienza nel campo delle Good Manufacturing Practices, che hanno approfondito la loro formazione collaborando con importanti aziende internazionali, l’azienda assicura una totale conformità ai requisiti qualitativi dell’FDA e degli equivalenti organismi europei. I servizi riguardano Engineering, Commissioning & Qualification, IT compliance, Process&Quality, Advanced therapies, training GxP.

Nell’ottica di un potenziamento della divisione, ricerchiamo una figura di:

Project Manager - Technology Transfer - Pharma

Entra a far parte della nostra divisione Life Sciences, un gruppo di circa 400 consulenti
che operano in Italia e circa 3.000 in Europa nelle Life Sciences attraverso le altre Region Europee. La nostra forza è da sempre l’integrazione delle nostre competenze, che ci permettono di avere una visione a 360° del mondo farmaceutico.

Quale sarà il tuo contributo in Akkodis?

Ti occuperai di:

Life Cycle Management
: Remediation/Formulation work, Transfer Technology, Regulatory projects, interfacciandosi con team cross-funzionali per realizzare con successo i progetti, a partire dalla definizione fino all'introduzione sul mercato
Pianificazione del progetto

Guidare team interfunzionali attraverso ogni fase del progetto
Coordinare tutte le attività del progetto
Monitorare e gestire i rischi e le opportunità

Preparare il budget e monitorare i costi

Collaborare con il management per definire gli aspetti del progetto
Emettere Technology Transfer Plan
coinvolgendo tutte le funzioni preposte alla compilazione del Technology Transfer Report

Profilo

Hai una laurea in discipline scientifiche e almeno tre anni di esperienza come Project Manager in ambito Technology Transfer?

Potrai entrare nel team di Process & Quality della divisione Lifesciences, e sviluppare le tue capacità nell'ambito del Project Management.

About you

Requisiti per iniziare il tuo percorso di crescita:

Esperienza come PM nel settore Life Science
Capacità di definire progetti/ Due Diligence/ preparazione Business Case
Ottime competenze in Project Management
Inglese fluente
Ottime capacità organizzative e di problem solving

Offerta

Contratto a tempo indeterminato, CCNL commercio, RAL a partire da 35.000€

Location

Remote

In Akkodis crediamo nel valore della diversità, dell’equità e dell’inclusione.

Ci impegniamo ogni giorno a costruire un ambiente di lavoro in cui ogni persona possa sentirsi accolta, rispettata e valorizzata, indipendentemente da età, genere, abilità, esperienza, cultura, orientamento sessuale, religione, disabilità o background socioeconomico.

Tutte le nostre offerte di lavoro sono aperte anche a persone con disabilità, in conformità con la Legge 68/99, e il nostro obiettivo è garantire un processo di selezione equo, accessibile e rispettoso delle esigenze individuali.

Per offrirti la migliore esperienza possibile durante il percorso di candidatura, ti invitiamo a segnalarci eventuali necessità specifiche legate alla tua disabilità, così da poter predisporre i giusti supporti e garantire un’interazione serena e inclusiva.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Yahoo serves as a trusted guide for hundreds of millions of people globally, helping them achieve their goals online through our portfolio of iconic products. For advertisers, Yahoo Advertising offers omnichannel solutions and powerful data to engage with our brands and deliver results.

The Mission

Yahoo is in the midst of a significant technology transformation. The Central Technology organization plays a critical role in how technology is built, operated and scaled across the company.

We are seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager to lead complex, cross functional technology initiatives across Central Technology and Yahoo. Reporting directly to the VP of Enterprise Strategy & Corporate Technology, this role will take on ambiguous, high impact programs that span multiple organizations and require strong technical judgment, cross functional leadership and executive alignment.

Programs may include technology asset management and CMDB, engineering standards and governance, technology modernization, AI and automation, operational excellence and other strategic priorities across Yahoo.

Who You Are

You are a systems thinker who can take ambiguous, complex problems and create structure, direction and an executable path forward.
You have the technical judgment to work credibly with senior engineers and architects while translating complex issues into clear decisions and outcomes.
You are an effective communicator who can influence across organizational boundaries, surface tradeoffs and drive alignment with senior stakeholders.
You focus on outcomes and use lightweight processes and governance to improve execution rather than creating process for its own sake.
You enjoy mentoring others, sharing best practices and raising the quality of technical program management across an organization.

Key Responsibilities

Lead complex, cross functional technical programs from strategy through execution, establishing clear outcomes, ownership, roadmaps and decision points.
Drive strategic initiatives including technology asset registry and CMDB capabilities, engineering standards and governance, and other cross cutting Central Technology priorities.
Partner with engineering leaders, architects, security, infrastructure and business stakeholders to identify dependencies, risks and tradeoffs and drive decisions across teams.
Establish lightweight governance and operating mechanisms that improve accountability, visibility and execution.
Identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation to improve program execution, engineering practices and operational effectiveness.
Translate complex technical and organizational issues into clear recommendations and executive level communications.
Define and promote technical program management best practices and mentor TPMs and other program leaders across the organization.
Serve as a trusted partner to Central Technology leadership on high priority initiatives as priorities evolve.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
10+ years of experience leading complex, cross functional technical programs or large scale technology initiatives.
Demonstrated ability to understand system architecture, technical dependencies and operational risks.
Experience working directly with engineering and technical teams to drive plans, decisions and outcomes.
Strong judgment and communication skills, with the ability to operate through ambiguity and influence technical and executive stakeholders.
Demonstrated experience mentoring others and establishing program management best practices.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working across enterprise technology, infrastructure, security or centralized technology organizations.
Experience with technology asset management, CMDB, engineering governance or similar cross organizational capabilities.
Experience leveraging AI or automation to improve operational efficiency and execution.

Yahoo is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, and will not be discriminated against based on age, race, gender, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability or any other protected category. Yahoo will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law. Yahoo is dedicated to providing an accessible environment for all candidates during the application process and for employees during their employment. jobs.title: Accounting Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Guesty is the all-in-one platform helping hospitality businesses around the world automate, optimize, and scale their operations. We’re a fast-growing global startup that’s transforming how the industry works — from guest experience to business growth.

With a powerful suite of features and integrations with 150+ industry partners — including Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com, Expedia, Google Travel, and many more — Guesty empowers property managers to deliver top-tier guest experiences while running more efficient, data-driven operations.

We’re proud to have over 900+ team members across 16 countries worldwide, all working together to build the future of hospitality technology.

If you’re looking to grow your career in a dynamic, global, and impact-driven environment, we’d love to hear from you.

We are looking for a Accounting Technical Program Manager to join our team. This role is open to candidates based remotely in Canada or the United States. Candidates located in the New York area will follow a hybrid schedule, with an expectation to work from our New York office two days per week.

As a Technical Program Manager (TPM) specializing in Accounting, you will serve as the dedicated Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the Guesty Accounting Module. Job Overview

About Relativity

Legal technology is having its moment — and Relativity is at the center of it.

We are a leading legal data intelligence company. Our extensible, AI cloud platform, RelativityOne, is trusted by the world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies to turn complex data into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, arbitration, and other high-stakes legal matters.

In Asia, the momentum speaks for itself: RelativityOne adoption jumped 46% year-over-year, a sign that organisations have moved beyond experimentation and are now applying AI in product environments to modernise how legal work gets done at scale.

To meet this moment, we’re expanding our Singapore team and on-the-ground presence. This is an opportunity to be part of an exciting growth story. We are looking for mid-level professionals across sales, technical solutions, customer success, and marketing to support our continued expansion. You’ll have the backing of an established industry leader and the opportunity to help grow our customer base across Asia.

If you’re ready to help write the next chapter of legal AI in Asia, we’d love to hear from you.

This is an exceptional opportunity for an excellent hands-on marketing program manager to help build and drive growth for Relativity in dynamic markets. As the Program Manager, Field Marketing — Asia, based in Singapore, you will own the development of the field marketing strategy and the delivery of marketing plans for the Asia region, with specific focus on Singapore, Hong Kong, India, and South Korea, with accountability for commercial outcomes in the region.

Serves as the in-region authority for all Asia events — including owning the regional presence at RelFest Sydney and flagship Asia events — leading audience acquisition campaigns, driving registrations and attendance goals, developing supporting content, and building event awareness across the region.

Collaborates cross-functionally with Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Brand, and Marketing Operations to ensure consistent messaging and campaign integration.
Partners with the global content team to execute against the regional content strategy, including the creation of customer success.
Serves as a trusted marketing partner to the in-market sales teams, keeping them informed of programme plans, campaign updates, and access to promotional materials, and building strong relationships that make marketing an integral part of commercial success.
Sets, tracks, and reports on campaign metrics and commercial KPIs; translates performance data into actionable insights and continually optimises programmes to improve outcomes and maximise ROI.

7+ years professional experience in marketing, with a track record of owning commercial outcomes in a senior field marketing or demand generation role.
Proven in-market experience across at least one Asia market (Singapore, Hong Kong, India, or South Korea)

Experience working in B2B technology or SaaS marketing environments with experience across more than one Asia market: Singapore, Hong Kong, India, or South Korea

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure’s Region Build Platform team is seeking a Technical Program Manager to improve how OCI services are tested, prepared, and deployed into new cloud regions. Our team connects service engineering, Region Build operations, and platform tooling teams to deliver reliable builds and advance toward automated, touchless region deployment.

You will drive programs across service onboarding, test lab readiness, and region build automation. This includes expanding adoption and ongoing use of test environments, coordinating end-to-end validation, and ensuring service configurations and dependencies are ready before a region build begins.

During active builds, you will work with engineers to understand failures, identify downstream impact, establish clear ownership, and drive recovery plans through successful validation. You will use those findings to prioritize long-term fixes, close testing gaps, reduce configuration drift, and eliminate repeated manual intervention across future builds.

We are looking for someone who can translate complex technical dependencies into executable plans, assess readiness using test and build evidence, and communicate clear risks and decisions to leadership. Success in this role means faster and more predictable region builds, effective use of test environments, and measurable reductions in recurring failures and operational effort.

Job Description

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure’s Region Build Platform team is seeking a Technical Program Manager to improve how OCI services are tested, prepared, and deployed into new cloud regions. Our team connects service engineering, Region Build operations, and platform tooling teams to deliver reliable builds and advance toward automated, touchless region deployment.

You will drive programs across service onboarding, test lab readiness, and region build automation. This includes expanding adoption and ongoing use of test environments, coordinating end-to-end validation, and ensuring service configurations and dependencies are ready before a region build begins.

During active builds, you will work with engineers to understand failures, identify downstream impact, establish clear ownership, and drive recovery plans through successful validation. You will use those findings to prioritize long-term fixes, close testing gaps, reduce configuration drift, and eliminate repeated manual intervention across future builds.

We are looking for someone who can translate complex technical dependencies into executable plans, assess readiness using test and build evidence, and communicate clear risks and decisions to leadership. Success in this role means faster and more predictable region builds, effective use of test environments, and measurable reductions in recurring failures and operational effort.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Technical Management and Execution - Technical Management:

– Leverages technical knowledge to identify risks, manage scope, estimate program timelines, request feasibility, testing requirements, and determine appropriate resources.

– Ensures that product or service delivery meets the third party, security, export, and accessibility compliance requirements.

– Leads the development and implementation of evolving processes to ensure that organizational SLAs are met.

Technical Management and Execution - Technical Strategy and Execution:

– Utilizes technical knowledge to identify, track, and manage program dependencies and risks.

– Supports rapid response to escalations, coordinating within team and communicating to senior team members to assess risk, determine mitigation strategies, and execute the optimal proposed path to resolution.

– Supports planning by identifying dependencies and risks.

Program Oversight - Strategy and Decision-Making:

– Aligns priorities with customers, service, and stakeholder teams through regular reporting to senior leadership.

Program Oversight - Program and Operations Management:

Program Oversight - Risk Management:

– Conducts comprehensive assessments of costs, benefits, and return on investment (ROI) to inform decision-making and risk mitigation strategies.

– Manages critical issues while making trade-offs between business needs and technical constraints.

– Removes blockers for the program and identifies new technical and resource options to efficiently deliver solutions and drive adoption.

Process Efficiency - Process Optimization:

– Leads program improvement, implementing best practices and driving cross-team process optimizations to improve processes.

– Organizes and develops program objectives and workflows, while testing and deploying cross-functional solutions to address critical business problems.

– Collaborates with management to initiate and maintain processes and procedures that guide and assist teams in reaching their goals.

Process Efficiency - Continuous Improvement:

– Leads efforts to integrate continuous improvement within programs, driving insights across many workstreams to generate recommendations that deliver operational efficiencies.

– Develops and standardizes data-driven decision-making frameworks, ensuring insights drive efficiencies.

– Identifies and addresses gaps to facilitate business-critical improvements to the solution's availability and reliability.

– Iterates processes based on feedback and KPIs, analyzing results through retrospectives.

– Defines requirements and configurations of existing and new development tools, where applicable.

Collaboration and Program Leadership - Cross Functional Collaboration:

– Facilitates collaboration across multiple teams, driving discussions that align priorities and program goals.

– Leads medium-scale efforts to optimize processes, identifying and implementing solutions that enhance team efficiency.

– Delivers program updates, risks, and opportunities to managers and leadership, influencing decision-making.

– Develops relationships with key stakeholders, ensuring their perspectives are integrated into program planning and execution.

Collaboration and Program Leadership - Program Leadership:

– Leads programs to continuously improve organizational efficiency.

– Provides technical direction and mentorship to cross-functional teams.

– Influences and guides change at all levels of the group from initiation through delivery.

– Ensures that the program team and other stakeholders are aligned with the program goals and motivated, identifying and addressing conflicts and issues.

Data and Analysis:

Stakeholder Engagement:

– Acts as a liaison with or between stakeholder teams, driving effective collaboration for customer success within Oracle commitments.

– Manages relationships with internal and external stakeholders to align program priorities and commitments.

– Identifies and documents stakeholder needs and works cross-functionally to implement solutions that enhance satisfaction.

– Identifies risks to customer satisfaction and advocates for improvements or mitigation.

– Assesses risks to customer satisfaction and evaluates mitigation efforts, providing solutions to the immediate team and related teams to ensure alignment on resolving these risks.

Planning & Execution:

Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.

jobs.description:
Healthcare’s helping hand.

CHG shook things up in 1979 by inventing the locum tenens staffing model. We connect doctors with patients who need their care. As the largest physician staffing firm in America, our providers treat millions of patients each year.

Our industry is growing and demand is high. This means you’ll have plenty of opportunities to grow and develop in your career. Keeping healthcare healthy can be as fun as it is rewarding

CHG has gone to market with MSP (Managed Service Provider) as a new offering. There are currently two confirmed MSP clients, with additional prospects in active conversation. CHG has dedicated Account Management resources for MSP and needs someone focused specifically on MSP implementations as part of ECS Operations.

The Sr. Implementation Manager, MSP is the operational owner of an MSP client implementation once a contract is signed. This role blends client-facing work, management of internal stakeholders and staffing vendors and project management of specific, named client MSP implementations, and is responsible for ensuring each MSP implementation is executed successfully.

On the client side, this role is the point of contact credible enough to sit with executive-level client stakeholders for implementation purposes, similar to how the Account Manager owns the account relationship for other CHG offerings. This is not an Account Management role; client-facing scope is limited to gathering and executing on MSP and operational-workflow requirements with the client’s Health Care Organization (HCO) stakeholders, not the broader client relationship.

On the internal side, this role functions as a program manager. It is not focused on technology adoption, that is Locumsmart’s role; instead, this role directs internal CHG stakeholders and client stakeholders, on what needs to happen for each implementation and holds them accountable to the project plan.

This role sits within ECS Implementation, reporting to the Manager, ECS Implementation Team, parallel to existing Implementation Managers on the team. Travel is estimated at 25% or more, driven by client request and need. Depending on MSP client volume, this role may not be full-time to start; Operational Strategy project work will be supplemented as capacity allows.

Responsibilities

Own MSP implementations end to end once a contract is verbally agreed upon with client, coordinating across CHG divisions and Locumsmart leadership through kickoff and ongoing delivery
Partner with the client to create the implementation project plan and ensure proper execution
Report on milestones and program progress to stakeholders and executive leadership. Responsible for raising red flags if the implementation is off track or identifying wins to replicate success
Direct internal stakeholders on what needs to happen for each MSP implementation and hold them accountable to the plan
Serve as the client point of contact for gathering MSP implementation requirements.
Responsible for outlining the overall implementation process and gaining buy-in from the client.
Travel as needed to support client implementations, estimated at 25% or more based on client request and need
At a program management level, track vendor outreach by Locumsmart to introduce the new program and connect vendors to the MSP AM team
At a program management level, verify the contracts team has executed Sub-Vendor Agreements (SVAs) with legacy and new staffing agencies for each MSP client, including the sub-vendor tiering strategy and the dispute-resolution protocol for dual-agency provider conflicts
At a program management level, ensure the AM team has built the Job Requisition Approval Chain and the Candidate Profile Auditing SOP for each client implementation, with support from the Program Team
At a program management level, verify all client data is appropriately stood up, transferred and ready for go-live
At a program level, work with Locumsmart team to ensure they drive adoption of the technology
May meet with the client for a brief period past go-live to ensure a quality implementation and that no adjustments are required. From there, client contacts will be consolidated to the ECS Account Management team and handoff is complete. This role could be engaged again, as the client agrees to new services and offerings.

What Success Looks Like

Implementation is completed on the mutually agreed timeline with the client, running in parallel with the Locumsmart (VMS) platform track
All required Sub-Vendor Agreements are executed prior to supplier go-live
A clean hyper-care handoff to the Account Management team, with no unresolved issues carried into steady-state support
Client and internal stakeholders report the implementation plan was followed with minimal rework or escalation

Qualifications

Prior experience in healthcare staffing, locum tenens, or MSP/VMS operations preferred over general technical or SaaS project management background
Working familiarity with VMS/contingent workforce platforms, ideally Locumsmart
Basic contract literacy, able to read and operationalize Master Services Agreements and Sub-Vendor Agreements
Previous implementation and/or program experience is desired. Prior client-facing experience is required.
Must be able to demonstrate a track record of leading cross-functional initiatives to completion.
Must be able to demonstrate experience planning and executing projects or programs with specific delivery examples.

College degree preferred

CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS:

at time of hire. Applicants selected will be subject to a U.S. Government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. Due to the nature of work performed within our facilities, U.S. citizenship is required.

Responsibilities For This Position

The D5LE2 Project Manager supports program planning and day-to-day execution within the Fire Control organization. This position integrates Earned Value Management, contract requirements, forecasting, baselining, risk and opportunity management, staffing coordination, and customer deliverables to achieve program objectives. The successful candidate will work closely with the Program Manager (PM), Control Account Managers (CAMs), Engineering, Contracts, Finance, and other stakeholders. Responsibilities include delegated reviews and approvals, leadership and customer presentations, and cross-functional coordination. This role requires demonstrated leadership experience or strong leadership potential, sound judgment, and the ability to drive actions to closure.

Key Responsibilities
Earned Value Management and Program Performance

Review preliminary monthly Earned Value metrics and lead monthly EV meetings.
Work with CAMs and other stakeholders to understand the root causes of cost and schedule variances, verify that required updates are accurately captured, and track corrective actions.
Review and approve Variance Analysis Reports (VARs), Baseline Change Requests (BCRs), and Corrective Action Plans (CAPs) within delegated PM authority.
Conduct driving-path reviews to identify schedule dependencies, execution risks, and potential impacts to program milestones.
Review and approve charge-number requests within delegated PM authority.

Forecasting and Baselining

Coordinate quarterly updates to labor, material, and orders forecasts with CAMs and the PM.
Maintain the Risk/Opportunity Forecasting Register and incorporate potential impacts into program forecasting.
Coordinate CLIN 1019 kickoff and baseline development, gathering cross-functional inputs and preparing review packages for leadership.
Develop baseline schedules with Engineering and coordinate requirements, dependencies, and commitments with affected stakeholders.
Review pricing runs, develop baseline review materials, and present recommendations with the PM.

Risk and Opportunity Management

Manage branch- and DDT-level risks throughout their lifecycle, including identification, assessment, review, approval, mitigation tracking, and retirement.
Identify and track opportunities, including ownership, action plans, and forecast impacts.
Communicate risk and opportunity status through applicable program, technical, milestone, leadership, and customer reviews.
Coordinate with Dahlgren in its role as prime to identify, align, and communicate risks and associated actions.

Staffing and Resource Coordination

Work with DPME to gather, validate, and submit staffing scorecard inputs to the Program Office.
Communicate staffing growth, resource gaps, staffing deltas, and required skill sets to leadership and customers.
Tailor staffing information to the audience and review forum, including YPRs, MMMs, PPRs, and customer one-on-one discussions.

Program Execution and Stakeholder Engagement

Support day-to-day execution by coordinating priorities, tracking commitments, resolving issues, and escalating concerns with recommended actions.
Develop meeting materials, participate in reviews, and present program status as required, including WSWG, YPR, and PPR forums.
Communicate cost, schedule, technical, staffing, and contractual performance to leadership and customers.
Lead cross-functional coordination and drive accountability for decisions, deliverables, and action closure.

Contract, Proposal, and Deliverable Management

Apply working knowledge of contract scope, CLIN structure, deliverables, modifications, and applicable requirements to program execution.
Support proposal analysis and execution, including Omnibus efforts, as applicable.
Perform CLIN lead responsibilities, coordinate quoting methodology and approach, support fact-finding actions, and assist with modifications and analysis through award and execution.
Manage the coordination, review, and timely delivery of Contract Data Requirements List (CDRL) submissions, including the Integrated Program Management Data and Analysis Report (IPMDAR).
Coordinate tracking and delivery of contractual incentive requirements.

Required Qualifications

Earned Value certification or demonstrated clear understanding and practical application of Earned Value Management, including performance metrics, variance analysis, baseline control, forecasting, and corrective actions.
Working knowledge of contracts and their relationship to program scope, CLINs, deliverables, changes, and execution commitments.
Familiarity with Fire Control systems, programs, or the associated engineering and execution environment.
Experience managing project scope, schedule, cost, resources, dependencies, and deliverables.
Proficiency with project management tools used for scheduling, cost analysis, forecasting, reporting, and action tracking.
Experience applying a structured risk and opportunity management process.
Experience preparing and presenting information to leadership and customers, including communicating performance, issues, and recommended actions.
Demonstrated leadership experience or leadership potential, evidenced by initiative, accountability, sound judgment, and the ability to influence cross-functional teams.
Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and drive actions to completion.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting D5LE2 or comparable Fire Control programs.
Experience working with CAMs and performing delegated PM reviews and approvals.
Experience with program baselining, pricing reviews, proposal development, and contract modifications.
Experience coordinating CDRLs, IPMDAR submissions, and contractual incentives.
Experience coordinating risks and execution activities with Dahlgren.
Experience leading program reviews and communicating staffing and resource requirements.

Job Description

Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World

Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a wide variety of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers.

This position provides an opportunity to transition from other private, public, government or military experience to a 3M career.

The Impact You’ll Make in this Role

Role

As a Senior IT Digital Program Manager, you will lead complex, multi‑million‑dollar digital initiatives from initial concept through production launch. You will drive enterprise‑wide technical programs, manage cross‑functional delivery teams, and ensure alignment with 3M’s strategic objectives. In this role, you will make an impact by:

Leading end‑to‑end delivery of large‑scale, complex Digital IT programs, including inception, planning, execution, and production rollout.
Managing multiple interconnected projects under a unified program structure, ensuring technical alignment and coordinated delivery.
Overseeing complex technical implementations and partnering with IT, engineering, and business teams to ensure successful integration.
Engaging and influencing senior stakeholders up to the SVP level, ensuring clear communication, alignment, and timely decision‑making.
Collaborating with functional leaders to build high‑performing program teams and ensure clear ownership across workstreams.
Identifying program risks and dependencies early, implementing proactive mitigation strategies, and maintaining program stability.
Managing vendors, negotiating contracts, and ensuring delivery quality aligns with program goals and sourcing requirements.
Owning program financials, including forecasting, tracking, and ensuring accountability for multi‑million‑dollar budgets.
Driving transparent, structured program reporting to leadership, enabling informed decisions and predictable delivery outcomes.
Demonstrating strong conflict‑resolution skills and maintaining program momentum through ambiguity and complex stakeholder dynamics.

Your Skills And Expertise

To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

Highschool diploma or higher (completed and verified prior to start)

Five (5) years’ experience in significant leadership roles on complex global programs in a private, public, government or military environment.
Five (5) years’ experience in overseeing global teams in a private, public, government or military environment.

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

Demonstrated ability to manage and develop high-performing teams within a matrixed organization.

jobs.title: 【Project Manager】 DXマイグレーション エンジニア／PL・PM
jobs.description:
■ポジション名
DXマイグレーション エンジニア／Project Lead・Project Manager

当社は世界で60年以上、日本で50年以上、基幹システムを支えてきた独立系SIerです。特定製品に縛られないベンダーフリーの立場で、メインフレームからクラウド・AIまでの変革を支援しています。

■ポジション概要と業務内容
メインフレーム等のレガシー環境からRed Hat・Azure・AWSなどのオープン環境への移行で、方式検討から本番移行までを担います。移行先での認証基盤（Keycloak）の設計・検証も、本ポジションの重要な役割です。
主な業務
1. 現行システムの調査と移行方式の検討（リホスト／リプラットフォーム／リファクタリング）
2. あるべきシステム構成の提案、見積もり、顧客とのスコープ・予算の折衝
3. 移行先の認証・認可基盤（Keycloak）の設計・構築・検証（SSO、OIDC／SAML連携など）
4. 基本設計〜詳細設計、テスト計画・移行計画の策定と実行
5. オフショアを含む開発チームのリード、進捗・品質・課題の管理
6. 生成AIを使ったドキュメント作成やコード変更提案の仕組みづくりへの参加
グレードにより担当範囲が変わります。アナリスト・シニアアナリストは3・4・6が中心、PLは4・5、PMは1・2・5を主に担います。

■プロジェクト事例＜内容＞
基幹システムのオープン化

汎用機のサポート終了（2028年予定）に備え、顧客のレガシーシステムをRed Hat・Azureへ移行
移行先の認証基盤の刺新

移行後のオープン環境で、Keycloakによる統合認証（SSO）の設計・検証を実施（現在急募）
大規模メインフレームのクラウド移行（他部門との連携案件）

大手企業のIBM z/OS・日立VOS3をAWSベースのオープン環境へ移行。Cloud & ITO部門がインフラを担当
AIを使ったコードモダナイゼーション

レガシーコードの分析・リファクタリング・変換を生成AIで効率化（DXCグローバルのMaaS）

■キャリアパス
移行案件で実績を積んだ後は、大規模・グローバル案件のPMや統括PMを目指せます。社内異動が多く、転職せずに別の領域に挑戦できるのも特徴です。

■働く環境・魅力
• 社会的意義の大きい案件：公共性の高いシステムや基幹システムの刺新を、上流から本番移行まで一貫して担えます
• AIを自由に使える環境：グローバルのAIツールをほぼ自由に利用可能。 Japan独自の生成AIツールも開発しています
• グローバルとの協業：国境を越えた人材活用ができる体制で、海外の優秀なエンジニアと案件を進められます
• ベンダーフリー：特定製品に縛られず、顧客にとって最適な構成を提案できます
• 働き方：フレックスタイム制（コアタイムなし）、完全土日祝休み
• 学習支援：3万以上のeラーニング、AWS・Azureなどの資格取得支援

【即面接】Keycloak認証技術の保有者
以下に該当する方は、書類選考を省いてすぐに面接を設定します。
• Keycloak（TCloak）を用いた認証・認可基盤の構築、または検証の実務経験
• 職務経歴書に「Keycloak／キークローク」「検証」の記載があれば対象

■必須要件（いずれかに該当）
Project Manager
• 50人月以上、または10名以上のチームでのPM経験
• 提案・見積、スコープや予算などについて顧客と折衝した経験
• 公共性の高いシステムまたは基幹業務システムでのPM経験（業界不問）
• COBOL・JCLなどレガシーシステムの知見、またはRed Hat・Azureなどオープン環境の知見

Project Lead／エンジニア
• 5名以上のチームでのリーダー経験、または今後PLを目指す意欲
• 公共性の高いシステムまたは基幹業務システムの開発経験
• レガシーシステム、またはオープン環境の知見

共通
• ビジネスレベルの日本語（外国籍の方はN2以上、日本語でのドキュメント作成が可能なこと）
• 学歴不問

■歓迎要件
• OAuth 2.0／OpenID Connect／SAML、SSO・多要素認証など認証技術全般の知見
• Red Hat製品（RHEL、Red Hat build of Keycloak／RH-SSO、OpenShift）の設計・構築経験
• メインフレーム（IBM z/OS、日立VOS3等）からオープン系への移行経験
• 基本設計〜内部設計、テスト仕様書作成などの設計スキル（開発経験4年以上）
• オフショアを活用したプロジェクトの経験
• 大規模プロジェクトでのPL経験、PMP保有
• ビジネス英語

■求める人物像
• 技術も顧客対応もマネジメントも担いたい方
• 上流工程（要件定義・方式検討）に関わりたい方
• ウォーターフォール開発で培った要求分析・設計力を、AI活用にも広げたい方
• 年功序列や「待ち」の文化より、自ら仕事をつくる環境を好む方

■想定年収
800~1,700万円

■JOB ID: VAC-296156

Governance & Project Management IT:
Pianificherai e coordinerai i progetti tecnologici dedicati alla rete vendita (sistemi POS, casse, infrastrutture di negozio, dispositivi di pagamento e soluzioni digitali), analizzando i processi operativi per individuare opportunità di efficientamento.

Supervisionerai le infrastrutture hardware/software e di rete (LAN, Wi-Fi, connettività) dei punti vendita, definendo ed implementando i piani di backup, sicurezza e disaster recovery.
Sinergia con il Business:

Service Management & Helpdesk:

Gestione Team & Fornitori:

Formazione & Change Management:
Promuoverai l'adozione degli strumenti tecnologici e la cultura digitale nella rete di vendita attraverso affiancamento e formazione.

Siamo aperti a valutare diverse seniority (da Middle a Senior)
. Cerchiamo:
Background Tecnico:
Formazione o solido percorso professionale in ambito Information Technology (Sistemi, Reti o Ingegneria/Informatica).
Esperienza Retail:
Fondamentale la conoscenza dei processi e dei sistemi IT a supporto dei punti vendita (POS, casse, infrastrutture retail).

Esperienza già maturata come IT Project Manager OPPUR
una forte seniority tecnica/operativa con la volontà e il potenziale per assumere la gestione completa dei progetti.
Attitudine:
Ottime doti di comunicazione, orientamento al problema (problem solving) e capacità di interfacciarsi sia con interlocutori tecnici che di business.

Inserimento in un’azienda leader, solida e fortemente radicata sul territorio.

Un ruolo centrale e ad alto impatto, con visibilità diretta sulle decisioni strategiche del business retail.

You'll operate at the center of Salesforce's highest-stakes customer migrations, with direct influence on how enterprises modernize their platforms. You'll work alongside Professional Services, SI partners, and product teams while pushing the boundaries of AI-native delivery.

Program Overview

GDIT delivers critical all‑source intelligence on foreign military and civilian cyber actors, their supporting infrastructure, and the broader ecosystems in which these capabilities operate. This intelligence directly supports foundational military intelligence (FMI) requirements for the joint force and ensures alignment with the mission portfolios.

On this program, GDIT provides a broad range of analytic and mission‑enabling support to produce operationally relevant FMI and scientific and technical intelligence (S&TI) for cyberspace operations. Our support is not limited to analysis; we engage across the entire intelligence cycle—planning, collection, processing, exploitation, production, and dissemination—while also executing integrated mission management functions.

All support is focused on enhancing the customers’ ability to enable both defensive and offensive cyberspace operations.

Position Overview - Cyber All‑Source Intelligence Analyst

The Cyber All‑Source Intelligence Analyst provides on‑site functional and technical intelligence support to the Intelligence Center. jobs.description:
Hiring near our Irving, TX, Stamford, CT and Fort Myers, FL Centers of Excellence with a flexible environment.

About Gartner IT:

Join a world-class team of skilled engineers who build creative digital solutions to support our colleagues and clients. We make a broad organizational impact by delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that power Gartner. Gartner IT values its culture of nonstop innovation, an outcome-driven approach to success, and the notion that great ideas can come from anyone on the team.

About The Role

This is a new role within Gartner's Security Operations team, focused on Digital Forensics and Incident Response (DFIR). As a Lead Analyst, you will be responsible for leading complex investigations, conducting forensic analysis across enterprise systems, and helping Gartner respond to, contain, and recover from cybersecurity incidents.

You will serve as a technical leader for investigations involving advanced threats, insider risk, legal and regulatory matters, and high-priority security events. This role requires deep expertise in digital forensics, evidence handling, incident response, and threat analysis, combined with the ability to communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

As part of a highly collaborative team, you will work closely with teams such as Security Operations, Threat Intelligence, Legal, Human Resources, Privacy, Compliance and Engineering to protect Gartner's people, data and intellectual property.

What You Will Do

Lead digital forensic investigations involving cybersecurity incidents, insider threats, human resources matters, legal requests, and regulatory inquiries.
Conduct forensic acquisition and analysis of endpoints, cloud workloads, network artifacts, log data, and volatile system evidence.
Develop and maintain DFIR playbooks and standard operating procedures that meet legal and evidentiary standards.
Perform advanced log analysis using multiple data sources to establish timelines, identify root cause, and validate investigative findings.
Develop automation and tooling that improve investigative efficiency and evidence collection capabilities.
Identify opportunities to improve Gartner's detection, response, forensic readiness, and evidence preservation capabilities.
Mentor junior investigators and contribute to the growth and maturity of Gartner's DFIR program.
Produce clear and defensible forensic reports suitable for internal stakeholders, auditors, legal counsel, and executive leadership.

What You Will Need

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Digital Forensics, related fields, or equivalent practical experience.
7+ years of experience in digital forensics and incident response, with at least 2 years in a senior or lead capacity, including experience leading complex incident response investigations.
Experience using Python, PowerShell or other similar scripting languages to automate and accelerate forensic workflows and evidence processing.
Hands on experience with digital forensics tools and platforms, including (but not limited to): Magnet Forensics, EnCase, Volatility, MemProcFS, FTK, KAPE, UAC, Autopsy/Sleuth Kit, Velociraptor or equivalent platforms.
Experience with cloud forensics in AWS and Azure environments, including investigations involving cloud-native services and Kubernetes/containerized workloads.
Strong hands-on experience in Windows, macOS, Linux, and memory forensics.
Strong proficiency with endpoint detection and response (EDR/XDR), SIEM and SOAR platforms (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Athena, etc.), network forensics (Zscaler, ExtraHop, Wireshark), and log analysis.
Experience performing malware analysis, reverse engineering, and threat hunting.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear forensic reports as well as explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
Experience running insider threat or HR/Legal driven investigations
Strong command of evidence handling, chain of custody, and forensically sound acquisition, including live response and remote collection.

Who You Are

Calm and decisive under pressure, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
A skilled investigator who can connect disparate data points and develop evidence-based conclusions.
A strong analytical thinker with exceptional attention to detail and a passion for problem-solving.
An excellent communicator capable of translating technical findings into business-relevant risk and actionable recommendations for leadership.
Driven to identify process gaps, improve workflows, and strengthen organizational response capabilities.
A collaborative partner who works effectively across technical, business, legal and executive teams.
Committed to continuous learning and staying current with evolving threats, tools, and investigative techniques.

What Will Make You Stand Out

Relevant industry certifications such as GCFA, GCFE, GNFA, GCIH, GREM, EnCE, or equivalent
Experience supporting legal, eDiscovery, compliance, privacy, or regulatory investigations.
Experience leveraging AI/LLMs to enhance DFIR investigations to improve investigative efficiency while preserving evidentiary standards
Familiarity with investigations involving AI-related security incidents or emerging technology risks.
Experience building custom forensic utilities, maintaining research projects, contributing to open-source tools, or publishing technical content.
Advanced experience integrating forensic, SIEM, EDR, and cloud security platforms through APIs and automation.

Competitive compensation.
Limitless growth and learning opportunities.
Ongoing mentorship and apprenticeship; Leadership courses, development programs, technical courses, certification opportunities and more!
A collaborative and positive culture - join a diverse team of professionals that are as smart and driven as you.

Gartner Gives Charity Match. And much more!

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

The ideal candidate will bring both vendor/BPO management expertise, and the analytical capability to validate, interpret, and act on data, enabling better decisions and driving change at scale.

Support Strategic Partnerships by serving as entry point and liaison for unique partner operational needs.
Lead initiatives that require coordination across Operations, Compliance, Product, Risk, Training, QA, and WFM.
Translate vendor insights into cross-functional actions that improve customer experience and compliance outcomes.

Champion continuous improvement and innovation across the vendor network.

The Program Manager II, Source to Pay - Value Optimization owns the business value layer of the S2P Reimagined program and serves as the business owner and single point of contact for process intelligence across the Source-to-Pay organization. This role translates S2P priorities into a prioritized and measurable portfolio of initiatives, governs benchmark frameworks, and drives value realization through actionable insights and program leadership.

Advanced degree or equivalent experience in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering, Finance, or a related field.

Experience bringing to bear process mining and process intelligence solutions, including Celonis, to identify optimization opportunities, improve performance, and drive measurable business outcomes.

About The Role

Smarsh is looking for a Senior Marketing Analyst to build the data foundation that marketing and go-to-market (GTM) teams run on — and that our AI tools will increasingly depend on. AI assistants and agents can only answer revenue questions reliably when the data model beneath them is clean, governed, and well defined. This role owns that layer for marketing: from source-system connectors and Snowflake, through dbt models and a governed semantic layer, to the dashboards, analysis, and AI-driven insight that leadership uses to make decisions.

You'll set the measurement and data roadmap, not just execute against it. You'll partner with Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, Sales/Revenue Operations, Customer Success, and IT/Data Architecture, and you'll be a trusted analytical partner to marketing and GTM leadership on planning, pipeline, and growth strategy.

How will you contribute?

AI-ready data foundation

Design and build an AI-ready data foundation for marketing and GTM: governed dbt models and a semantic layer (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, LookML, Omni) with consistent metric definitions that both people and AI tools can query.
Prioritize foundation domains in partnership with RevOps and IT — starting with marketing performance and attribution, and connecting to pipeline, account hierarchy, and customer retention data.
Build validation and testing frameworks (data tests, reconciliation checks, and accuracy evaluation of AI-generated answers) so AI assistants and agents return answers leadership can trust.
Partner with Marketing Operations and IT to deploy and improve AI tools (e.g., Claude, BI-native AI agents) that answer recurring marketing and pipeline questions in a self-serve way.

Data architecture & engineering

Own the marketing data architecture end to end: source-system connectors, ingestion into Snowflake, transformation logic, orchestration, and curated data models.
Build and maintain reliable pipelines (e.g., Salesforce, Marketo, Marketo Measure/Bizible, ABM, Google/LinkedIn/Bing Ads, sales engagement platforms) using ELT and orchestration tooling such as Fivetran and Airflow, with monitoring and documented SLAs.
Model account hierarchies and lead-to-account matching so marketing engagement rolls up correctly to accounts, buying groups, and opportunities.

Measurement, attribution & analytics

Own the design, governance, and evolution of marketing attribution (W-Shaped, Custom Model, and account-level influence), including documenting assumptions and limitations.
Lead ABM measurement: account engagement scoring, buying-group coverage, intent-to-pipeline conversion, and target-account progression.
Go beyond descriptive reporting — apply cohort analysis, funnel velocity, incrementality/test-and-control design, and forecasting to answer "what's working, and what should we do next?"
Analyze campaign and channel performance (organic search, paid search, paid social/ABM, display, email, events, field) and deliver prioritized recommendations on budget and program mix.

Strategy, reporting & stakeholder leadership

Partner with marketing and GTM leadership on annual planning, pipeline targets and coverage, growth strategy, and operating cadences, bringing the analysis that grounds those decisions.
Build and own executive-grade dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Looker, Tableau, Omni) reconciled against Salesforce and finance data, and own the analytics behind monthly/quarterly business reviews and QBRs.
Define and govern a single set of marketing metric definitions (MQL/MQA, SAL, pipeline sourced vs. influenced, CAC, ROI) and drive adoption across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.
Set and maintain the marketing analytics roadmap: prioritize requests, balance ad hoc work against foundational builds, and communicate trade-offs.

Data quality, governance & enablement

Establish data quality standards and automated checks across CRM, marketing automation, and the warehouse; fix root causes rather than patching symptoms.
Ensure marketing data and AI use align with Smarsh data privacy, security, and governance requirements in partnership with Legal, Security, and IT.
Mentor analysts and Marketing Operations teammates on SQL, dbt, data modeling, and responsible use of AI in analytics.

What will you bring?

5+ years of experience in GTM, marketing, or revenue operations analytics, or business intelligence, ideally in B2B SaaS or technology.
Advanced SQL and hands-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse (e.g., BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks), including designing data models, not just querying them.
Hands-on dbt experience building production-grade, tested, documented models.
Experience building or governing a semantic or metrics layer (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, LookML, Omni, or a BI-native equivalent).
Experience with ELT and orchestration tooling (e.g., Fivetran, Airflow, or similar).
Deep working knowledge of Salesforce data structures (leads, contacts, accounts, opportunities, campaigns, campaign members) and Marketo or a comparable marketing automation platform.
Expert BI skills in at least one major platform (e.g., Power BI, Looker, Tableau, Omni, Hex), including governed, self-serve dashboard design.
Proven experience designing and governing multi-touch attribution and ABM reporting, and explaining methodology and its limits to non-technical executives.
Practical, hands-on use of AI tools (e.g., Claude, Claude Code) in analytics work, and a clear point of view on what makes data AI-ready.
Track record of owning an analytics roadmap and influencing senior stakeholders with data.
Excellent written and verbal communication; able to turn complex analysis into a concise business narrative.

Bonus Skills & Experience

Experience building or evaluating AI agents or LLM-based assistants that answer business questions over a governed data model, including accuracy testing.
Python or R for statistical analysis, automation, or modeling (e.g., forecasting, propensity, marketing mix or incrementality analysis).
Experience with Marketo Measure (Bizible) at an administrator or model-design level.
Familiarity with the broader GTM data ecosystem: sales engagement and conversation intelligence (e.g., Salesloft, Outreach, Gong), data enrichment and hygiene (e.g., Clay, RingLead), ABM/intent platforms, and product analytics (e.g., Heap, Amplitude).
Experience supporting annual planning, territory design, pipeline coverage modeling, or retention KPIs.
Experience in a regulated industry (financial services, healthcare, or similar) where data accuracy and auditability are especially important.
Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Business, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

$106,000 - $141,000 a year

jobs.description:
As a team member in Finance at Nationwide, a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, the opportunities are endless! Let Nationwide help create your career journey! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

The hired associate must reside within 35 miles of the following location:

Columbus: One Nationwide Plaza, Columbus OH, 43215

Work schedule: 3 days in office, 2 days remote.

This role does not qualify for employer sponsored work authorization. Nationwide does not participate in the STEM OPT extension program.

Job Description Summary

Nationwide’s industry leading workforce is passionate about creating data and business intelligence solutions that are secure, reliable, accessible, and efficient in support of our mission to provide extraordinary care. Nationwide embraces an agile work environment and collaborative culture through the understanding of business processes, relationship entities and requirements using data analysis, quality, visualization, governance, engineering, robotic process automation, and machine learning to produce targeted data solutions. If you have the drive and desire to be part of a future forward data enabled culture, we want to hear from you.

As an Investment Data Management professional, you will serve as the primary liaison between the business and Technology, developing and driving data and analytic strategies and solutions to deliver prioritized business capabilities. You will be responsible for creating and maintaining the vision for the data ecosystem, with focus on improving efficiency, effectiveness, and quality of data-driven business processes and decisions. Your role provides business-minded thought leadership throughout all phases of data development, including intake, work initiation, requirement gathering and iteration planning and project estimations. You will serve as the data-related voice of the customer in translating functional data and analytic requirements into solutions for consumption and use by the respective business area, managing communications between Technology and business, resolving blockers/questions/support needs, conducting/coordinating User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and approving releases. You will evaluate potential data impacts, coordinate with stakeholders, and serve as steward for data governance, access rights/audits and defect resolution.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

Identifies, executes, and communicates data strategy opportunities, defining long-term goals and key performance indicators to further a data-driven culture in support of business priorities.
Consults and provides direction on acquisition, curation, and consumption of data for analytical and operational uses, producing data source documentation and assisting with development and maintenance of reference data and mastering rules to ensure a single version of the truth across all data consumers.
Collaborates on mapping the end-to-end flow of data and the business processes and/or technical interfaces which would be created or impacted and recommends solutions/adaptations.
Develops collaborative relationships with business, Technology, and vendor partners, communicating data impacts and promoting transparency around data issue identification and resolution.
Prompts data, reporting and analytic requirements from business requestors to generate solutions.
Participates in planning and execution of UAT, triage issues and works with development team on remediation approach to ensure data integrity.
Performs data management activities, including classifying information into logical categories, generating data lineage, developing data quality and transformation rules, conducting complex data profiling, implementing data monitoring techniques using standardized tools, reviewing daily exceptions, reloading data, and applying data overrides as necessary.
Uses moderate to complex visualization techniques and skills to present data in support of business needs.
Enforces data governance structure, standards, and procedures to ensure data is well-defined, consistent, accurate, accessible, and secure.
Governs all data access requests and has final right of refusal for accesses.
Demonstrates knowledge and understanding of investment asset classes, and those data elements most critical to support business processes.
Integrates emerging data and analytic trends, competitive research, and industry best practices into Nationwide.

May Perform Other Responsibilities As Assigned.

Reporting Relationships:
Reports to AVP or Data Leader

Typical Skills And Experiences

Education:
Undergraduate studies in computer science, management information systems, business, statistics, math, a related field or comparable experience and education strongly preferred. Graduate studies in business, statistics, math, computer science or a related field are a plus.

License/Certification/Designation:
Certifications are not required but encouraged.

Experience:
6-10 years of relevant experience with data management organization/standards or practices. Experience engaging business leaders, data architects and external consultants to identify and fill gaps in data and analytics environment. Proficient in data acquisition, data wrangling and/or data visualization techniques and tools (i.e., SQL, R, Python, Tableau, Power BI, etc.), and cloud technologies – Azure and AWS (i.e., Redshift, S3, EC2, etc.). Experience in statistical analysis, interpreting results in determining data quality and fit for purpose. Insurance/financial services industry knowledge a plus.

Knowledge, Abilities And Skills

Data application and practices knowledge, with expertise using SQL to perform data analysis (experience in Snowflake and Databricks preferred)
Sound decision making and strong analytical skills with high attention to detail and accuracy
Exhibits interpersonal skills and effective written and oral communication
Ability to work independently and as part of a team
Ability to effectively adapt to rapidly changing technology and apply it to business needs
Demonstrated expertise in building relationships, facilitating meetings, influencing others, and setting priorities

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the hiring manager’s leader and HR Business Partner.

Values:
Regularly and consistently demonstrates Nationwide Values

Job Conditions

Overtime Eligibility:
Not Eligible (Exempt)

Working Conditions:
Normal office environment.

Benefits

We have an array of benefits to fit your needs, including: medical/dental/vision, life insurance, short and long term disability coverage, paid time off with newly hired associates receiving a minimum of 18 days paid time off each full calendar year pro-rated quarterly based on hire date, nine paid holidays, 8 hours of Lifetime paid time off, 8 hours of Unity Day paid time off, 401(k) with company match, company-paid pension plan, business casual attire, and more. We combine deep engineering expertise with global-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide.

This isn’t theoretical work. It’s real systems, at real scale, people solving some of the hardest challenges in technology today.

We’re looking for people who want to build, solve, and operate at that level.

Join us and let’s shape the future of data.

Job Description

Broad Functions

Lead and Data manage for improve the Transportation service, Site service (Canteen service, Janitorial , Uniform, Locker, Postal, WD store and supply) and Workplace Improvement project with regard of company policies to achieve higher productivity, quality, efficiency and effectiveness of all resources. Support the Organizational Goals in achieving Total Customer Satisfaction

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

This job is responsible for delivering the organization outcome as stated:

Data Sourcing and Collection: Define and collect data from various Facility systems, Workplace Improvement systems, Transportation Service system, Site Service system (Transportation Service data, Canteen service data, Janitorial data, Locker Service data and other).
Data Preparation: Perform Data Cleansing & Shaping on Facility system, Workplace improvement system, Site Service data to ensure high data quality and readiness for analysis.
Insight Generation: Analyze data to identify anomalies, track consumption rates, utilization ,consumption costs, and measure system performance metrics.
Reporting and Visualization: Create and maintain automated Dashboards (e.g., using Power BI/Tableau) to regularly present key performance indicators (KPIs) to the management and teams.
Deep Dive Analysis: Conduct in-depth analysis to support cost reduction initiatives and increase performance projects within the department.
Actionable Recommendations: Translate complex technical data into clear, actionable recommendations that guide decisions on Manage the service and system improvements.
Transition manual work to systematic process using automation and technology and digital tool.
Leverage AI and Machine learning to predict trends, optimize processes and enhance decision-making.
Provide service cost analysis including new service cost analysis.
Support FE&M Cost reduction program / energy saving program management and control.
Summary cost saving projects status for the department.
Coordinate with all concerned groups to measure and collect data for service improvement.
Ensure all the transportation service, site service activities, workplace improvement are complied with the related company procedure such as safety procedure, RBA, IMS, BCMS, Thai regulation, etc.
Conduct a meeting with Transportation, canteen committee, EHS or related parties on transportation Service, site service program updates.
Ensure and improve the customer satisfaction score to meet FE&M organization’s goal.
Support special project assignments.

Qualifications

REQUIRED:

Bachelor's degree or higher in an engineering field, Computer Science, Logistics, or any related field
2 year+ experience in a related field.
Excellent verbal and Written communication skills in Thai and English.

SKILLS:

Soft Skills

Problem-Solving: Possess strong analytical and logical thinking to determine the root cause of issues from large, complex datasets.
Business Acumen: Demonstrate a strong understanding of the Site Service Systems such Transportation, Canteen Service and the operational needs of a manufacturing plant.
Communication & Presentation: Possess excellent ability to communicate technical findings and deliver data-driven stories effectively to both technical and managers.
Coordination skills

Technical Skills

Proficiency in Microsoft office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) for data analysis, reporting and documentation.
Statistics and Math: Proficiency in basic statistical concepts and calculations.
BI & Visualization: Expert skill level in using BI Tools like Power BI or Tableau for data visualization and dashboard creation.
Database Querying: Strong capability in writing SQL Queries to extract data from various databases (e.g., SQL Server).
Data Handling: Basic knowledge of ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes and tools (e.g., SQL Server Integration Services, Power Query).
Programming (Plus): Foundational knowledge of programming languages like Python for more advanced data manipulation and statistical analysis is highly preferred.

Additional Information

WD thrives on the power and potential of diversity. As a global company, we believe the most effective way to embrace the diversity of our customers and communities is to mirror it from within.
