jobs.title: Research Analyst
Equity Research Analyst | Private Placements
jobs.description:
Overview

Heights Capital Management (Heights) manages investments directly in publicly traded companies, typically through negotiated transactions: PIPEs, registered directs, confidentially marketed offerings, convertibles and warrant-linked structures.

As an analyst at Heights, you will have a variety of responsibilities including identifying companies likely to raise capital, building the diligence to enable investment managers to accurately outline risks related to prospective transactions, and updating investment managers on existing portfolio companies. You will work directly with the investment managers from deal inception to pricing. This is a small team so you will be trusted with substantive work quickly.

What You’ll Do

Identify potential investments

Screen US-listed companies for capital need using cash runway, burn rate, shelf and ATM capacity, upcoming catalysts and trading liquidity.
Monitor SEC filings (e.g. 10-Q, 10-K, 8-K, S-3, 424B5), sell-side research, news flow and banker deal flow to keep a live pipeline of candidates.
Develop and maintain the desk's watchlist and candidate tracker, and help refine the screening tools behind it.
Support reverse-inquiry outreach by preparing company one-pagers

Prepare due diligence

Build and maintain financial models covering runway, dilution, capital structure and warrant or convertible scenarios under different pricing outcomes.
Analyze management track record, prior financings and their terms, competitive position, and, for healthcare names, the clinical and regulatory picture.
Write concise investment memos with cited sources and exact figures, and present recommendations to the desk.
Join management and banker calls, track open questions through to answers, and coordinate with legal and compliance on wall-cross and restricted-list status.

Support portfolio companies

Monitor positions for catalysts, earnings, filings and cash position, and flag changes that affect our thesis or our securities.
Maintain relationships with management and investor-relations teams as an ongoing point of contact.
Evaluate follow-on financing requests, warrant amendments and exercise decisions, and track registration rights and covenant terms.
Prepare periodic portfolio reviews and ad hoc analysis for the desk.

What We're Looking For

2 to 5 years in equity research, investment banking (ECM), a buy-side analyst seat, or transaction advisory.
Strong accounting and modeling skills, and fluency reading SEC filings in detail.
Working knowledge of how PIPEs, registered directs, ATMs and warrant transactions function. Direct deal experience is a plus.
Comfort operating on deal timelines, where a decision can be needed within a day.
High integrity and discipline around material non-public information and wall-cross restrictions.
Excel and Bloomberg proficiency. SQL or Python is a plus, as is an interest in automating repetitive parts of the process.
Visa Sponsorship for work authorization is not available for this position now or in the future.

Nice to have

CFA progress or completion
Experience valuing options, warrants or convertible SEC

About Susquehanna

Susquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm powered by scientific rigor, curiosity, and innovation. Our culture is intellectually driven and highly collaborative, bringing together researchers, engineers, and traders to design and deploy impactful strategies in our systematic trading environment. To meet the unique challenges of global markets, Susquehanna applies machine learning and advanced quantitative research to vast datasets in order to uncover actionable insights and build effective strategies. By uniting deep market expertise with cutting-edge technology, we excel in solving complex problems and pushing boundaries together.

At HDR, our employee-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. Watch Our Story:' https://www.hdrinc.com/our-story'

Each and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.

We believe transportation is more than movement—it’s the foundation of connected, thriving communities. As part of HDR’s Transportation Business Group, you’ll help shape the systems that move people and goods safely, efficiently, and sustainably. From designing resilient highways and iconic bridges to advancing transit, passenger and freight rail, aviation, federal transportation ports and marine infrastructure, your work will directly support economic vitality, public safety, sustainable and resilient communities and quality of life. Coordinate staffing and workload through entire project life cycle, and ensure completion of deliverables on schedule

Implement QA/QC procedures
Supervise large project staffs and act as mentor for less-experienced Project Managers
Perform other duties as needed

Master's degree

Preference is given to local candidates
Previous Experience with an A/E/C firm

10 years related experience

Requires professional engineering license recognized by the licensing board for the location of the position offered. Example: Professional Engineer (PE or P.Eng) license.

Demonstrated leadership, business development and strategic planning skills
An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee-owned culture is a must

HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.

As employee owners, we all have a role in creating an inclusive environment where each of us is welcomed, valued, respected and empowered to bring our authentic selves to work every day.

Our eight Employee Network Groups (Asian Pacific, Black, Hispanic/Latino(a), LGBTQ+, People with Disabilities, Veterans, Women, Young Professionals) help create a sense of belonging and foster a supportive environment where everyone is empowered to engage and contribute. jobs.title: Senior Traffic Engineer / Project Manager
jobs.description:
What You Will Do

As GFT continues to grow and expand, we are seeking a Senior Traffic Engineer / Project Manager
to support our Transportation group in New York
. This role follows hybrid work model
, requiring regular attendance at our Woodbury, NY or New York, NY offices.

Working on the roadway / traffic team at GFT
offers the opportunity to engage in transformative projects that enhance transportation infrastructure and improve community connectivity. Whether working on highways and bridges or traffic engineering, our team excels in resilient, sustainable design and construction, delivering innovative solutions that address the complexities of modern, multimodal roadway systems and ensure safe, efficient, and reliable travel for all. Explore some of our signature roadway projects here.

What You’ll Be Challenged To Do

As a Senior Traffic Engineer / Project Manager, you will lead traffic engineering and design efforts on a variety of transportation projects throughout New York City and Long Island. You will play a key role in the planning, analysis, design, and delivery of traffic and transportation improvements while coordinating with multidisciplinary teams, agency stakeholders, and project managers.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing technical tasks, mentoring junior staff, and ensuring the delivery of high-quality engineering solutions that improve mobility, safety, and operational efficiency for clients including NYSDOT, NYCDOT, MTA, and local municipalities.

In this capacity, the successful candidate will be responsible for the following:

Lead traffic engineering and traffic design tasks from project initiation through final design and construction support.
Perform and oversee operational analyses and simulations using Synchro/SimTraffic, VISSIM, Highway Capacity Software (HCS), and other traffic analysis tools.
Prepare and review technical memoranda, traffic impact studies, operational analyses, traffic forecasting studies, and engineering recommendations.
Apply the Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices (MUTCD), NYSDOT and NYCDOT standards, and other applicable guidelines to leading with signing and striping design, signal warrant studies and maintenance and protection of traffic (MPT/MOT) plans.
Lead and review the development of traffic signal plans, including phasing, timing, detection, communications/interconnect systems, controller specifications, and signal warrant analyses.
Interface with clients, agency reviewers, and project stakeholders during project development, design reviews, and public outreach activities.
Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior engineers and designers.
Support project managers with scope development, scheduling, budget management, and proposal preparation.
Ensure designs comply with applicable federal, state, and local standards, policies, and engineering best practices.

Education | Experience:

What You'll Bring To Our Firm

Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering.
Professional Engineer (PE) License in New York, or ability to obtain reciprocity within six months.
8–12 years of progressively responsible experience in
Traffic engineering, traffic signal design, and transportation design.

Demonstrated experience leading traffic design and traffic engineering tasks for NYSDOT, NYCDOT, MTA, or other public-sector transportation agencies.
Strong experience in traffic operations analysis, traffic impact studies, and traffic signal design.
Experience preparing contract plans, specifications, estimates, and supporting construction documentation.
Proficiency with MicroStation, ProjectWise, and Microsoft Office Suite.
Working knowledge of Synchro/SimTraffic, VISSIM, HCS, and related traffic analysis software.
Working knowledge of transportation design standards, MUTCD requirements, and agency design manuals.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to effectively coordinate with clients, agencies, and multidisciplinary teams.
Ability to independently manage technical assignments and oversee the work of junior staff.

What We Prefer You Bring

PTOE certification or ability to obtain in 1 year.
Familiarity with NYSDOT Highway Design Manual, Traffic Signal Design Manual, MUTCD, ADA/PROWAG requirements, and ITE methodologies.
ITS, traffic management systems, or transportation technology experience.
Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $125,000 - $165,000
; Salary is dependent upon experience and geographic location.

Featured Benefits

Hybrid (in-person and remote) work environment.
Comprehensive benefits package including wellness programs, parental leave, and pet insurance, in addition to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance.
Tax-deferred 401(k) savings plan.
Competitive paid-time-off (PTO) accrual.
Tuition reimbursement for continued education.
Commitment to professional development, access to internal and external training programs, and support of active participation in professional organizations.
Incentive compensation for eligible positions.

Company Overview

At GFT, a privately held AEC firm, we innovate where transportation, water, power and buildings converge. We call this the Infrastructure of Life. We measure our success by the strength of our relationships – that’s why we’re the employer of choice for 5,000+ of the industry’s brightest engineers, planners, architects, inspectors, designers, and more.

Our clients choose us for our expertise and prefer us for our nimble approach, creativity, and personal touch. Backed by over a century’s experience, together we’re building a lasting legacy for future generations: stronger communities, a healthier planet, and better lives. GFT: Ingenuity That Shapes Lives™

GFT is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veterans’ status or other characteristics protected by law.

Unsolicited resumes from third party agencies will be considered the property of GFT.

Location: Woodbury, NY or New York, NY

Working Hours: 8 AM – 5 PM

Employment Status: Full-time

jobs.description:
Website Project Manager

BX Studio | Remote | Contract Fractional

About BX Studio

BX Studio is a digital agency specializing in Webflow website design, development, and
optimization. We partner with clients to create high-performing, visually compelling websites that
drive results. Our team is committed to delivering exceptional quality and maintaining long-term
client relationships through ongoing support and website maintenance. We pride ourselves on
our collaborative culture, technical expertise, and dedication to staying at the forefront of web
development best practices.

The Role

BX Studio is looking for a detail-oriented Website Project Manager
to oversee and coordinate
work that we do for our Webflow website projects. This role focuses on managing incoming
client requests, delegating tasks to the BX Studio teams, and ensuring timely project
completion. The ideal candidate has experience in managing multiple projects, has a strong
project management background, understands Webflow's ecosystem, and excels in
communication and team coordination.

Key Responsibilities:

● Client Communication:
Act as the primary point of contact for clients, addressing their
website maintenance needs, gathering requirements, and setting clear expectations.
● Sales:
Experience supporting sales and enthusiasm for contributing to sales efforts.
● Task Delegation:
Assign tasks to the development team based on expertise and
workload, ensuring efficient project execution.
● Project Tracking:
Monitor progress on all maintenance requests, ensuring timely
completion and adherence to quality standards.
● Issue Resolution:
Troubleshoot and manage any project blockers, collaborating with
developers and clients to find effective solutions.
● Process Optimization:
Develop and refine workflows to improve efficiency in handling
maintenance tasks.
● Documentation:
Maintain records of client requests, project status, and completed
tasks to ensure transparency and accountability.
● Quality Assurance:
Review completed work to confirm it meets client requirements and
Webflow best practices.
● Stakeholder Reporting:
Provide regular updates to clients and internal stakeholdersregarding project status, roadblocks, and resolutions.

Required:

● 2-3 years proven experience in project management, preferably in website maintenance
and Webflow projects.
● Experience in a digital agency or similar environment.
● Experience in sales
● Familiarity with general CMS (Webflow preferred), front-end development, and website
troubleshooting.
● Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple client requests
simultaneously.
● Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to liaise between clients and the BX
studio design and development teams.
● Experience using project management tools like Asana, Trello, Jira, or similar.
● Ability to work independently and proactively address issues as they arise.
● Problem-solving mindset with a keen eye for detail.

● Knowledge of basic HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
● Understanding of UX/UI principles and SEO best practices.
● Certification in project management (PMP, Agile, or similar) is a plus.

jobs.title: Lead Security Analyst (Digital Forensics and Incident Response)
jobs.description:
Hiring near our Irving, TX, Stamford, CT and Fort Myers, FL Centers of Excellence with a flexible environment.

About Gartner IT:

Join a world-class team of skilled engineers who build creative digital solutions to support our colleagues and clients. We make a broad organizational impact by delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that power Gartner. Gartner IT values its culture of nonstop innovation, an outcome-driven approach to success, and the notion that great ideas can come from anyone on the team.

About The Role

This is a new role within Gartner's Security Operations team, focused on Digital Forensics and Incident Response (DFIR). As a Lead Analyst, you will be responsible for leading complex investigations, conducting forensic analysis across enterprise systems, and helping Gartner respond to, contain, and recover from cybersecurity incidents.

You will serve as a technical leader for investigations involving advanced threats, insider risk, legal and regulatory matters, and high-priority security events. This role requires deep expertise in digital forensics, evidence handling, incident response, and threat analysis, combined with the ability to communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

As part of a highly collaborative team, you will work closely with teams such as Security Operations, Threat Intelligence, Legal, Human Resources, Privacy, Compliance and Engineering to protect Gartner's people, data and intellectual property.

What You Will Do

Lead digital forensic investigations involving cybersecurity incidents, insider threats, human resources matters, legal requests, and regulatory inquiries.
Conduct forensic acquisition and analysis of endpoints, cloud workloads, network artifacts, log data, and volatile system evidence.
Develop and maintain DFIR playbooks and standard operating procedures that meet legal and evidentiary standards.
Perform advanced log analysis using multiple data sources to establish timelines, identify root cause, and validate investigative findings.
Develop automation and tooling that improve investigative efficiency and evidence collection capabilities.
Identify opportunities to improve Gartner's detection, response, forensic readiness, and evidence preservation capabilities.
Mentor junior investigators and contribute to the growth and maturity of Gartner's DFIR program.
Produce clear and defensible forensic reports suitable for internal stakeholders, auditors, legal counsel, and executive leadership.

What You Will Need

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Digital Forensics, related fields, or equivalent practical experience.
7+ years of experience in digital forensics and incident response, with at least 2 years in a senior or lead capacity, including experience leading complex incident response investigations.
Experience using Python, PowerShell or other similar scripting languages to automate and accelerate forensic workflows and evidence processing.
Hands on experience with digital forensics tools and platforms, including (but not limited to): Magnet Forensics, EnCase, Volatility, MemProcFS, FTK, KAPE, UAC, Autopsy/Sleuth Kit, Velociraptor or equivalent platforms.
Experience with cloud forensics in AWS and Azure environments, including investigations involving cloud-native services and Kubernetes/containerized workloads.
Strong hands-on experience in Windows, macOS, Linux, and memory forensics.
Strong proficiency with endpoint detection and response (EDR/XDR), SIEM and SOAR platforms (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Athena, etc.), network forensics (Zscaler, ExtraHop, Wireshark), and log analysis.
Experience performing malware analysis, reverse engineering, and threat hunting.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear forensic reports as well as explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
Experience running insider threat or HR/Legal driven investigations
Strong command of evidence handling, chain of custody, and forensically sound acquisition, including live response and remote collection.

Who You Are

Calm and decisive under pressure, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
A skilled investigator who can connect disparate data points and develop evidence-based conclusions.
A strong analytical thinker with exceptional attention to detail and a passion for problem-solving.
An excellent communicator capable of translating technical findings into business-relevant risk and actionable recommendations for leadership.
Driven to identify process gaps, improve workflows, and strengthen organizational response capabilities.
A collaborative partner who works effectively across technical, business, legal and executive teams.
Committed to continuous learning and staying current with evolving threats, tools, and investigative techniques.

What Will Make You Stand Out

Relevant industry certifications such as GCFA, GCFE, GNFA, GCIH, GREM, EnCE, or equivalent
Experience supporting legal, eDiscovery, compliance, privacy, or regulatory investigations.
Experience leveraging AI/LLMs to enhance DFIR investigations to improve investigative efficiency while preserving evidentiary standards
Familiarity with investigations involving AI-related security incidents or emerging technology risks.
Experience building custom forensic utilities, maintaining research projects, contributing to open-source tools, or publishing technical content.
Advanced experience integrating forensic, SIEM, EDR, and cloud security platforms through APIs and automation.

Don’t meet every single requirement? We encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be the right candidate for this, or other roles!

What you will get:

Competitive compensation.
Limitless growth and learning opportunities.
Ongoing mentorship and apprenticeship; Leadership courses, development programs, technical courses, certification opportunities and more!
A collaborative and positive culture - join a diverse team of professionals that are as smart and driven as you.
A chance to make an impact – your work will contribute directly to our strategy.
Enjoy the flexibility of working from home and the energy of collaborating with peers in our dynamic offices.
20+ PTO days plus holidays and floating holidays in your first year.
Extensive medical, dental insurance and vision plan.
401K with corporate match, immediate vesting.
Health-and-wellness-related allowance programs.
Parental leave.
Tuition reimbursement.
Employee Stock Purchase Plan.
Employee Assistance Program.
Gartner Gives Charity Match. And much more!

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. jobs.description:
Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.

Work You'll Do

As a Consultant, Functional Transformation on the Sales & Service team, you will be responsible for:

Facilitate interviews, workshops, requirements sessions, and working meetings to elicit, analyze, document, validate, and prioritize business requirements.
Analyze current-state processes, identify pain points, and translate business needs into process flows, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional requirements.
Coordinate with client stakeholders, business users, architects, developers, and product owners to support future-state process and solution discussions.
Investigate business and client issues, clarify root causes, track risks, issues, decisions, dependencies, and action items, and coordinate resolution.
Support Salesforce-enabled business process and customer relationship management (CRM) solutions by preparing training materials, standard operating procedures, job aids, and user acceptance testing (UAT) materials, and by participating in change-management and Agile delivery activities.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Sales & Service offering designs and implements sales and service experiences, capabilities, and architectures required to bring customer strategies to life.

Qualifications

Required :

Bachelor's degree
1+ years of experience performing business analysis tasks, including requirements gathering, process analysis, stakeholder management, data collection, and data analysis
1+ years of experience within the product development lifecycle, including concepting/prototyping, research, design, workflows, etc.
Ability to travel 0-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

Experience using Salesforce, performing Salesforce configuration, completing Salesforce training, or holding a Salesforce credential
Experience with grant development, evidence review, and manuscript drafting and editing
Degree in psychology or completed coursework in psychology
Experience supporting federal, state, or local government agencies or public higher education institutions
Experience applying foundational Agile concepts, including user stories, backlog refinement, sprint planning, and retrospectives
Experience using Anthropic Claude Code

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $82,600 to $162,800.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.

Work You'll Do

As a Consultant, Functional Transformation on the Sales & Service team, you will be responsible for:

Facilitate interviews, workshops, requirements sessions, and working meetings to elicit, analyze, document, validate, and prioritize business requirements.
Analyze current-state processes, identify pain points, and translate business needs into process flows, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional requirements.
Coordinate with client stakeholders, business users, architects, developers, and product owners to support future-state process and solution discussions.
Investigate business and client issues, clarify root causes, track risks, issues, decisions, dependencies, and action items, and coordinate resolution.
Support Salesforce-enabled business process and customer relationship management (CRM) solutions by preparing training materials, standard operating procedures, job aids, and user acceptance testing (UAT) materials, and by participating in change-management and Agile delivery activities.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Sales & Service offering designs and implements sales and service experiences, capabilities, and architectures required to bring customer strategies to life.

Qualifications

Required :

Bachelor's degree
1+ years of experience performing business analysis tasks, including requirements gathering, process analysis, stakeholder management, data collection, and data analysis
1+ years of experience within the product development lifecycle, including concepting/prototyping, research, design, workflows, etc.
Ability to travel 0-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

Experience using Salesforce, performing Salesforce configuration, completing Salesforce training, or holding a Salesforce credential
Experience with grant development, evidence review, and manuscript drafting and editing
Degree in psychology or completed coursework in psychology
Experience supporting federal, state, or local government agencies or public higher education institutions
Experience applying foundational Agile concepts, including user stories, backlog refinement, sprint planning, and retrospectives
Experience using Anthropic Claude Code

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $82,600 to $162,800.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.description:
Company Description

Located on the sun-drenched Kohala Coast, on sacred land marked by royal fishponds, natural lava plains, lush tropical gardens, and alluring beaches, Mauna Lani – meaning “mountain reaching heaven” – is an inspiring spiritual haven, defining a new era of experiential luxury on the Island of Hawaii. A resort for the generations, with contemporary guest rooms, suites, and private residences, CanoeHouse oceanfront dining, three distinct pools, a signature spa and wellness haven, and Kainalu Ocean Sports program, set the tone for transformational experiences and enriching cultural immersion.

For more information: auberge.com/mauna-lani

Follow Mauna Lani on Facebook and Instagram @MaunaLaniAuberge

Job Description

The base salary range for this position is $90k - $100k.

Join our team as Project Manager and become one of the authors of our story. As part of the Auberge family, you will be responsible for managing projects and annual capital expenditure (CapEx) of the resort.

Develop and manage annual capital expenditure (CapEx) budgets aligned with ownership and business goals.
Does the timely ordering and purchasing of all project related items, equipment, furniture, supplies, and services. Essential to the process would be the negotiation of the best price for value. Obtains two to three bids or quotations as applicable to facilitate this process. Processes purchase requisitions on a timely basis. Follow-ups on orders to ensure specifications are met.
The Capital Project Manager oversees planning, budgeting, execution, and delivery of capital improvement projects across hotel properties to enhance guest experience, operational efficiency, brand standards, and asset value.
Coordinate with hotel operations teams to minimize guest disruption during project execution.
Manage project scope, timelines, budgets, and quality standards to ensure successful delivery.
Oversee design development, contractor selection, procurement, and construction administration.
Collaborate with architects, engineers, consultants, and vendors to ensure compliance with brand and operational requirements.
Conduct site inspections and monitor construction progress, identifying risks and implementing corrective actions.
Prepare project status reports and communicate progress, risks, and financial updates to leadership and ownership groups.
Maintain accurate project documentation including permits, drawings, warranties, and closeout records.
Partner with departments such as Engineering, Finance, Operations, and Procurement for seamless project delivery.
Participate in management training sessions, communication and planning meetings.
Participate in employee and community relations functions.
Participate in Promotional Events outside of the resort as needed.
Performs other duties as required.

Qualifications

Minimum: High School Graduate.
PMP certification (Project Management Institute) preferred.
Minimum: 1+ years of project management or similar experience in hospitality, commercial construction, or facilities capital projects.

Additional Information

Auberge Collection is a portfolio of extraordinary hotels, residences, and private clubs. While each property is unique, all share a crafted approach to luxury and bring the soul of the locale to life through captivating design, exceptional cuisine and spas, and gracious yet unobtrusive service. With hotels across three continents, Auberge invites guests to create unforgettable stories in some of the world’s most desirable destinations. Please visit auberge.com to learn more about our Collection. Follow us on Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Pinterest: @Auberge and #AlwaysAuberge.

A bit about us:

We are a mid-size, family owned GC established in Northern Virginia for over 60 years. Projects include Class A office interiors, historical preservation, healthcare, retail, and some education.

Why join us?

Stable and respected contractor with a strong project backlog
Diverse portfolio of commercial construction projects
Collaborative leadership team that values employee input
Strong emphasis on quality, safety, and professional development
Opportunity to lead challenging and high-profile projects

Long-term growth opportunities within the organization

Job Details

Job Details:

We are currently seeking an experienced, dynamic Interiors Project Manager to join our thriving Construction team. This is an exciting opportunity for a seasoned professional to manage a diverse portfolio of commercial interior projects. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in commercial construction, with a proven track record of delivering high-quality projects on time and within budget. This role is perfect for a driven individual who thrives in a fast-paced, challenging environment and is eager to make a significant impact on our company's success.

Responsibilities:

As an Interiors Project Manager, you will:

1. Oversee all aspects of commercial interior projects from conception to completion, ensuring they meet quality, safety, and cost objectives.
2. Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients, architects, subcontractors, and other project stakeholders.
3. Manage project scope, timelines, and budgets, identifying and mitigating risks as necessary.
4. Coordinate and supervise the work of project teams, including architects, engineers, laborers, and subcontractors.
5. Review and approve project designs and plans, ensuring they align with client objectives and comply with relevant regulations and standards.
6. Monitor project progress, addressing any issues that arise and ensuring timely completion.
7. Conduct site inspections to ensure adherence to project specifications and safety standards.
8. Prepare and present regular project reports to senior management and stakeholders.
9. Implement and enforce company policies and procedures, promoting a culture of safety and excellence.

Qualifications:

The successful candidate will have:

1. A minimum of 5 years of experience in commercial construction, with a focus on interior projects.
2. Proven experience as a Project Manager or similar role in the construction industry.
3. A deep understanding of construction procedures, materials, and project management principles.
4. Strong knowledge of construction health and safety regulations.
5. Exceptional leadership and team management skills, with the ability to motivate and inspire teams.
6. Excellent problem-solving abilities and a keen eye for detail.
7. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain strong relationships with a diverse range of stakeholders.
8. The ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
9. Proficiency in project management software and other relevant computer applications.
10. A bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Architecture, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.

Join us and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of commercial interiors. We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, along with opportunities for professional growth and development. If you are a dedicated, results-driven professional with a passion for excellence, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager I
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About The Operations Team

The Operations team delivers seamless customer experiences and enables new product capabilities while ensuring operational excellence. The team owns strategy, planning, technical execution, customer service, fraud operations, process design, quality, training, and program management. We drive efficiency, resolve issues quickly, and scale operations as the business grows. Our goal is to deliver seamless support while maintaining high standards and reducing risk.

About The Role

Affirm’s mission is to deliver honest financial products to improve lives. We do this by partnering with top companies to offer responsible financial products at the point of sale. Working jointly with our clients, Affirm co-develops and executes on joint partnership strategies to innovate and grow the business.

We are seeking a Partner Manager to lead performance and transformation across our global BPO vendor network. This role is accountable for driving vendor excellence and customer satisfaction at scale, while also shaping long-term vendor strategy and leading large cross-functional initiatives. The ideal candidate will bring both vendor/BPO management expertise, and the analytical capability to validate, interpret, and act on data, enabling better decisions and driving change at scale.

This is a senior leadership role within Operations, with direct accountability for outcomes across multiple functional areas, across customer needs and requiring significant strategic oversight, cross-functional leadership, and sharp analytical judgement.

What You’ll Do

Own vendor performance, including customer experience, service-levels, compliance, and QA outcomes.
Lead executive-level vendor governance (e.g. QBRs, escalations).
Define operational strategies for horizontal services across the vendor network.
Partner with the Business Analyst team to shape what metrics and dashboards are needed to run the business.
Use data to diagnose performance gaps, validate trends, and prioritize interventions.
Run ad-hoc analyses and scenario modeling to support rapid decision-making.
Support Strategic Partnerships by serving as entry point and liaison for unique partner operational needs.
Lead initiatives that require coordination across Operations, Compliance, Product, Risk, Training, QA, and WFM.
Translate vendor insights into cross-functional actions that improve customer experience and compliance outcomes.
Act as senior escalation point for systemic issues.
Drive key initiatives such as product/process rollouts, vendor migrations, or regulatory implementations.
Design and execute structured change programs, ensuring vendor readiness and sustained adoption.
Champion continuous improvement and innovation across the vendor network.

What We Look For

8+ years of expertise in vendor/BPO management, operations, or related fields
Strong analytical background with the ability to define the right questions, work with analysts to build the right tools, and run independent analysis when needed.
Proven ability to drive vendor accountability through scorecards, governance, and structured interventions.
Track record of leading large, cross-functional programs with measurable business impact.
Exceptional communication and influencing skills with internal and vendor executives.
Experience managing vendor networks of 2,000+ agents across multiple geographies (preferred).
Industry background in fintech, technology, or high-growth customer operations (preferred).
Knowledge of compliance-heavy functions (Fraud, Payments, Compliance) (preferred).
Skilled at turning complex data into clear narratives for senior leadership (preferred).

Pay Grade - L

Equity Grade - 6

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $165,000 - $225,000

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $146,000 - $206,000

Remote-first with flexibility built in

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits Designed For You

Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

jobs.title: Program Manager, ACA & BHP (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
Resp & Qualifications

PURPOSE:

Drives ACA and BHP Risk Adjustment performance through performance monitoring, analytics, and strategic initiatives. Identifies trends, opportunities, and performance gaps; develops improvement strategies; and communicates results to stakeholders by translating operational performance into measurable business and financial outcomes. Collaborates across departments to improve risk adjustment revenue, forecasting accuracy, and overall program effectiveness.

We are looking for an experienced professional in the greater Baltimore/Washington metropolitan area who is willing and able to work in a hybrid model. The incumbent will be expected to work a portion of their week from home and a portion of their week at a CareFirst location based on business needs and work activities/deliverables that week.

Essential Functions

Analyzes aggregate ACA and BHP Risk Adjustment performance across the line of business, leveraging reporting, operational metrics, and financial results to identify trends, risks, performance gaps, and improvement opportunities. Conducts detailed analyses of risk score performance, coding trends, transfer payment results, submission outcomes, and financial performance, translating findings into actionable recommendations that support organizational objectives.
Monitors and reports on key performance indicators, including risk score performance, coding trends, transfer payment results, submission outcomes, financial impact, and market competitiveness. Synthesizes complex data into clear, actionable insights and communicates business implications, opportunities, and risks to leadership and P&L stakeholders.
Evaluates drivers of risk adjustment performance across ACA and BHP populations and identifies opportunities to improve risk score outcomes, transfer payment performance, and overall program effectiveness. Reviews performance against state, regional, and national benchmarks and recommends strategies to maintain or exceed market performance.
Partners with business, clinical, operational, financial, analytics, compliance, provider, and vendor stakeholders to investigate performance drivers, validate findings, and support implementation of improvement initiatives. Assesses the impact of regulatory and model changes on operational and financial performance and influences decision-making by connecting analytical findings to measurable business and financial outcomes.

Supervisory Responsibility

Leads a team utilizing a matrix management system.

Qualifications

Education Level:
Bachelor's Degree in Business Management or related field OR in lieu of a a Bachelor's degree, an additional 4 years of relevant work experience is required in addition to the required work experience.

Licenses/Certifications Preferred

Certified Project Management Professional (PMP)-PMI.

Experience:
8 years project management or program management experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's Degree
Project Management Professional Certification (PMP)
8+ years in managing risk adjustment programs and provider incentives
5+ years in value-based care for Commercial or ACA
5+ Provider Engagement or Provider Enablement in Commercial or ACA

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities (KSAs)

Ability to synthesize large complex data and analysis into clear, concise, executive level presentations that allow for rapid grasp of business problem or opportunity and understanding of feasible solutions.
Effective understanding of how functions integrate within the division and the strategic concept behind the corporate goals.
Ability to translate business needs as it relates to technology, systems, and vendor platforms.
Ability to identify and shepherd strategic opportunities that have a significant impact on the organization. Ability to establish working relationships and influence/persuade across all levels of leadership including C-Suite.
Knowledge and discipline of Process Improvement.
Use of Microsoft Applications.
Must be able to meet established deadlines and handle multiple customer service demands from internal and external customers, within set expectations for service excellence. Must be able to effectively communicate and provide positive customer service to every internal and external customer, including customers who may be demanding or otherwise challenging.

Salary Range:

jobs.description:
Description

Business Analyst Project Manager (US - Washington DC)

What to expect when you join Sikich.

Team members at Sikich, have a lot in common while also being part of a rich and varied group of contributors, creating a distinct and thriving culture. Chief among our commonalities is a desire for growth and a shared unity of purpose in our professional lives. We believe that through diverse perspectives, challenging the status quo and rewarding action, we accelerate innovation and drive growth – for our clients, for ourselves and for our communities.

The professional services landscape continues to evolve. For Sikich, this means we have an opportunity to further cement our leadership position in this industry and continue to grow our organization in increasingly exciting ways. This growth is meaningful for every team member at our company because larger companies simply see more interesting client opportunities and can attract impressively talented individuals like you. Through a dedicated focus on key business priorities and intentionally creating a rewarding employee experience, Sikich, has developed into a highly regarded provider of professional services and a sought-after employer of choice.

Do you want to work with other skilled and agile practitioners who thrive on challenge and growth? We believe everyone has untapped potential. That’s why we lead with vision and act fast, pairing deep expertise with practical solutions. Our teams cut through complexity and deliver real impact. It's our hope that you find more than just a job. At Sikich, you'll find optimism, clear insights and genuine warmth, without egos.

Are you ready to grow with us?

Position summary

This is a surge support position through January 15, 2027.
Extension is possible but not guaranteed. The position is hybrid, with the office in Washington, DC, supporting a federal client and requires an active public trust or better clearance. Remote candidates will be considered.

Sikich seeks an experienced Technical Business Analyst and Project Manager to support a federal client infrastructure operations team through dual capabilities: (1) assessing technical and operational workflows to identify automation and AI opportunities, and (2) managing multiple infrastructure and cloud migration initiatives from planning through delivery.

This hybrid role combines process improvement analysis with project delivery coordination. You will assess the team's technical and business processes, document workflows and dependencies, identify gaps and bottlenecks, recommend improvements, manage project schedules and risks, remove delivery roadblocks, and communicate status to leadership. You will work closely with engineering staff, project sponsors, and program leadership to improve service delivery, reduce manual effort, accelerate cloud migration timelines, and create measurable gains in productivity and operational outcomes.

This role requires United States citizenship and a Public Trust. Preference is given to candidates located in the National Capital Region, including Washington, DC, Maryland, and Virginia.

What will you do in this role?

You will combine business analysis and project management to drive infrastructure modernization and operational improvements:

Analysis & Process Improvement

Map and document existing technical and business processes, identifying inefficiencies and automation candidates
Partner with engineering staff to validate findings and help implement approved recommendations
Advise on adoption of Microsoft 365 tools, including Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot, and related AI capabilities
Develop measurements to report on productivity and outcome improvements resulting from changes
Produce detailed technical and business process workflow documentation

Project Delivery & Coordination

Manage multiple infrastructure projects from planning through delivery
Develop and maintain integrated schedules, milestones, risks, issues, dependencies, action items, and decision logs
Manage Jira tickets and Confluence pages for assigned projects and ensure project documentation remains current
Facilitate meetings, document discussions and decisions, assign follow-up actions, and remove delivery roadblocks
Support adoption and refinement of agile and SAFe practices in an infrastructure operations environment
Aggregate technical inputs and publish concise status reports for client and company leadership
Create, edit, review, and coordinate formal project deliverables and presentation materials

What do you need to succeed in this role?

Empathy, patience and professionalism when working directly with end users, including the ability to explain technical steps clearly over remote sessions.
Sound judgment to ask for help, appropriate escalation of issues, and the ability to provide enough technical detail for senior administrators to act quickly.
Basic Excel proficiency for tracking device lists, remediation status, deployment results, and issue trends.
Ticketing system literacy, with ServiceNow and/or JIRA experience helpful but trainable on the job.

Desired Qualifications:

Required background includes hands-on experience in both of the following areas:

Business Analysis & Process Improvement:

8+ years’ experience in project management
7+ years' experience in process analysis, documentation, and process improvement
4+ years' hands-on experience with Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and AI capabilities (Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot)
Demonstrated experience documenting current-state and future-state workflows, facilitating working sessions with technical and business stakeholders, developing process maps and standard operating procedures, and translating findings into actionable recommendations
Experience in federal government, regulated, or enterprise IT environments

Project Management & Delivery:

8+ years' total information technology experience
7+ years' experience managing complex IT projects
5+ years' experience in a client-facing role
2+ years' experience supporting federal government or government-contracting environments
Demonstrated infrastructure and/or cloud project management experience
Hands-on, current experience with Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Visio, and Microsoft Office

In compliance with this state’s pay transparency laws, the salary range for this role is $135,000- $140,000 - $145,000 (25%-50%-75%)
. This is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, as final offer amount may vary based on factors including but not limited to experience and geographic location.

In addition, successful candidates will bring a service-oriented mindset, clear communication, sound troubleshooting judgment, and the ability to work collaboratively with technical teams and end users in a remote federal client environment.

Servant Leader – You are hyper focused on engaging employees, fostering their development, and building a positive culture.
Solutions Focused – You see opportunities in every business problem and can develop, articulate, and implement solutions.
Collaboration – You are a relationship builder across all levels of the organization and across all business units.
Instills Trust - You do what you say, and you follow through on commitments, you act with integrity, you are consistent and are perceived as credible.
Impact & Influence Thinking – You gain support for ideas, proposals, and solutions, and get others to act, with or without formal authority, to advance initiatives/objectives.

About Sikich,

Sikich, offers the public and private sectors a diverse platform of professional services across consulting, technology, and compliance. Highly specialized and hands-on teams deliver integrated solutions rooted in deep industry experience. Our approach is strategically and thoughtfully designed to help our clients, teams and communities accelerate success.

Sikich, has approximately 2,000 team members and operates across North America, EMEA and APAC.

Sikich, Total Rewards

Our team members enjoy expansive benefits ranging from competitive compensation and insurance options to wellness programs and a flexible time off policy, to name only a few. Sikich subsidiary also takes pride in prioritizing team members’ health, total wellbeing and time spent with family, friends and in the pursuit of personal goals, hobbies, and endeavors.

Some examples of our many benefits:

Sikich, maintains a Flexible Time Off (FTO) Policy. We encourage every full-time employee, as your role permits, to utilize paid time off (personal time, mental/physical health care, vacation, sick leave, etc.). Waiting for time off to accrue is common at other companies. At Sikich, you do not have to wait for this benefit to kick in. FTO is activated on your first day with our organization.
Sikich, will also recognize paid holidays during the year and strives to permit employees to have time off the last week of the calendar year when client and project work permits.
Sikich, offers a comprehensive wellness program to engage, challenge and empower team members to take responsibility for their wellbeing. Activities can be tracked through our wellness provider to obtain gift cards and other rewards.

HDR’s Water Business Group is expanding, and we’re seeking accomplished

Are you ready to take the next step with a firm recognized for excellence? Do you thrive in a collaborative environment where your leadership supports high-performing teams delivering innovative solutions for valued clients? That’s the culture you’ll find at HDR.

We believe water is more than a resource, it's a shared responsibility. As part of our Water Business Group, you’ll help shape how communities manage water for generations to come. From delivering safe drinking water and treating wastewater responsibly to developing sustainable water supplies and protecting lives and property through flood control, your work will directly support public health, environmental sustainability, and infrastructure resilience. We bring together experts across disciplines to solve complex challenges with bold thinking and technical excellence. Whether you're modernizing aging systems or pioneering innovative approaches, your contributions will make a meaningful difference in people’s lives. Provide mentorship and technical leadership to staff, fostering a culture of growth and excellence within the team.
Support firmwide initiatives and contribute to strategic planning and operational improvements across the business group.

10 years related experience

Professional Engineer (PE or P.Eng) license
MS Office and MS Project experience (Access experience would be plus)
Demonstrated leadership, business development and strategic planning skills
An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee-owned culture is a must

What We Believe

HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.

Our Commitment

As employee owners, we all have a role in creating an inclusive environment where each of us is welcomed, valued, respected and empowered to bring our authentic selves to work every day.

Job Description:

Program Overview

GDIT delivers critical all‑source intelligence on foreign military and civilian cyber actors, their infrastructure, and the broader ecosystems in which they operate. This intelligence directly supports foundational military intelligence (FMI) requirements for the joint force and aligns with mission portfolios.

On this program, GDIT provides a wide range of analytic and mission‑enabling support to produce operationally relevant FMI and scientific and technical intelligence (S&TI) for cyberspace operations. We support the full intelligence cycle—planning, collection, processing, exploitation, production, and dissemination and perform integrated mission management.

All support is focused on enhancing the customer’s ability to conduct both defensive and offensive cyberspace operations.

Position Overview

Yahoo serves as a trusted guide for hundreds of millions of people globally, helping them achieve their goals online through our portfolio of iconic products. For advertisers, Yahoo Advertising offers omnichannel solutions and powerful data to engage with our brands and deliver results.

The Mission

Yahoo is in the midst of a significant technology transformation. The Central Technology organization plays a critical role in how technology is built, operated and scaled across the company.

We are seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager to lead complex, cross functional technology initiatives across Central Technology and Yahoo. Reporting directly to the VP of Enterprise Strategy & Corporate Technology, this role will take on ambiguous, high impact programs that span multiple organizations and require strong technical judgment, cross functional leadership and executive alignment.

Programs may include technology asset management and CMDB, engineering standards and governance, technology modernization, AI and automation, operational excellence and other strategic priorities across Yahoo.

Who You Are

You are a systems thinker who can take ambiguous, complex problems and create structure, direction and an executable path forward.
You have the technical judgment to work credibly with senior engineers and architects while translating complex issues into clear decisions and outcomes.
You are an effective communicator who can influence across organizational boundaries, surface tradeoffs and drive alignment with senior stakeholders.
You focus on outcomes and use lightweight processes and governance to improve execution rather than creating process for its own sake.
You enjoy mentoring others, sharing best practices and raising the quality of technical program management across an organization.

Key Responsibilities

Lead complex, cross functional technical programs from strategy through execution, establishing clear outcomes, ownership, roadmaps and decision points.
Drive strategic initiatives including technology asset registry and CMDB capabilities, engineering standards and governance, and other cross cutting Central Technology priorities.
Partner with engineering leaders, architects, security, infrastructure and business stakeholders to identify dependencies, risks and tradeoffs and drive decisions across teams.
Establish lightweight governance and operating mechanisms that improve accountability, visibility and execution.
Identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation to improve program execution, engineering practices and operational effectiveness.
Translate complex technical and organizational issues into clear recommendations and executive level communications.
Define and promote technical program management best practices and mentor TPMs and other program leaders across the organization.
Serve as a trusted partner to Central Technology leadership on high priority initiatives as priorities evolve.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
10+ years of experience leading complex, cross functional technical programs or large scale technology initiatives.
Demonstrated ability to understand system architecture, technical dependencies and operational risks.
Experience working directly with engineering and technical teams to drive plans, decisions and outcomes.
Strong judgment and communication skills, with the ability to operate through ambiguity and influence technical and executive stakeholders.
Demonstrated experience mentoring others and establishing program management best practices.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working across enterprise technology, infrastructure, security or centralized technology organizations.
Experience with technology asset management, CMDB, engineering governance or similar cross organizational capabilities.
Experience leveraging AI or automation to improve operational efficiency and execution.

Yahoo is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, and will not be discriminated against based on age, race, gender, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability or any other protected category. Yahoo will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law. Yahoo is dedicated to providing an accessible environment for all candidates during the application process and for employees during their employment. If you need accessibility assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability, please submit a request via the Accommodation Request Form (www.yahooinc.com/careers/contact-us.html) or call +1.866.772.3182. Requests and calls received for non-disability related issues, such as following up on an application, will not receive a response.

Yahoo has a high degree of flexibility around employee location and hybrid working. In fact, our flexible-hybrid approach to work is one of the things our employees rave about. Most roles don’t require specific regular patterns of in-person office attendance. If you join Yahoo, you may be asked to attend (or travel to attend) on-site work sessions, team-building, or other in-person events. When these occur, you’ll be given notice to make arrangements.

If you’re curious about how this factors into this role, please discuss with the recruiter.

The compensation for this position ranges from €94,500.00 - €157,500.00 /yr and will vary depending on factors such as your location, skills and experience. Your package may also include incentive compensation opportunities in the form of discretionary annual bonus or commissions. Our benefits include healthcare, pension and a flexible package you can adapt to your own needs.

Currently work for Yahoo? Please apply on our internal career site.

new_jobs.title: Accounting Technical Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Guesty is the all-in-one platform helping hospitality businesses around the world automate, optimize, and scale their operations. We’re a fast-growing global startup that’s transforming how the industry works — from guest experience to business growth.

With a powerful suite of features and integrations with 150+ industry partners — including Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com, Expedia, Google Travel, and many more — Guesty empowers property managers to deliver top-tier guest experiences while running more efficient, data-driven operations.

We’re proud to have over 900+ team members across 16 countries worldwide, all working together to build the future of hospitality technology.

If you’re looking to grow your career in a dynamic, global, and impact-driven environment, we’d love to hear from you.

We are looking for a Accounting Technical Program Manager to join our team. This role is open to candidates based remotely in Canada or the United States. Candidates located in the New York area will follow a hybrid schedule, with an expectation to work from our New York office two days per week.

As a Technical Program Manager (TPM) specializing in Accounting, you will serve as the dedicated Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the Guesty Accounting Module. In this role, you will act as a key technical and financial partner to our Enterprise and Strategic customers, guiding them through complex accounting workflows, owner statements, and critical end-of-month financial processes.

Beyond enterprise support, you will drive proactive product adoption, ensuring clients achieve the financial optimization necessary for long-term retention and expansion. You will work in close strategic partnership with the Customer Success Management (CSM) team to analyze client workflows, identify adoption gaps, and safeguard account health.

Internally, you will serve as the definitive "Voice of the Customer" to our Product and Engineering teams—advocating for enterprise financial needs to shape our product roadmap. Additionally, you will be the backbone of accounting expertise for the broader TPM team, handling advanced accounting escalations and driving ongoing team enablement on best practices and new features.

Responsibilities:

Key Responsibilities:

Enterprise Partnership & Product Adoption

Month-End Financial Support: Provide dedicated guidance to enterprise and strategic accounts during high-stakes end-of-month closing cycles, ensuring smooth reconciliations, payouts, and statement generation.
Proactive Product Adoption: Analyze enterprise accounting setups to drive deeper feature utilization, streamline financial workflows, and increase overall product stickiness and retention.
CSM Strategic Partnership: Partner closely with Customer Success Managers (CSMs) on shared strategic accounts to align technical and accounting excellence with overall client retention and health goals.
Advanced Accounting Consultations: Lead complex consultations for enterprise clients to translate intricate property management accounting requirements into optimized Guesty Accounting Module configurations.

Internal Enablement & Voice of the Customer

Voice of the Customer (VoC): Synthesize real-world client challenges, accounting feedback, and market requirements to advocate directly with Product and Engineering teams for strategic roadmap enhancements.
Accounting Escalations SME: Act as the primary escalation point for the technical program management team on complex accounting, ledger, and reconciliation discrepancies.
Team Enablement & Training: Lead continuous enablement for internal team regarding new feature releases, property management accounting best practices, and operational standards.

Key Skills:

﻿Accounting & Financial SME: Deep functional knowledge of property management accounting, trust accounting, owner payout statements, ledgers, bank reconciliations, and month-end closing processes.
Technical Aptitude: A solid background in navigating complex SaaS environments and a natural ability to master intricate technical use cases.
Strategic Problem-Solving: The ability to analyze customer configurations and workflows to provide optimal, scalable solutions.
Expert Communication & Training: Exceptional presentation skills with a talent for translating dense technical concepts into simple, actionable guidance for both clients and internal teams.
SaaS Product Advocacy: Experience collaborating with Product organizations to vocalize feature requests, provide tangible feedback, and advocate for impactful roadmap releases.
Proactive Drive: High level of initiative to identify adoption gaps, improve customer setup, and collect meaningful product feedback.
Analytical Thinking: The ability to identify trends across account cohorts and use data to track evolving product needs.
Adaptability & Evolution: A proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and a proactive embrace of change—whether adopting new internal tools, evolving systems, or leveraging developing automations to improve efficiency.
(Bonus) Market Knowledge: Familiarity with the short-term rental market, the OTA landscape (Airbnb, Vrbo, etc.), and the property management software ecosystem.

Requirements:

Minimum of 4 years of technical experience within the SaaS software industry or in a technology-driven environment
Deep hands-on experience with trust accounting, property management accounting, or financial SaaS platforms.
Demonstrated experience handling enterprise/strategic accounts during high-pressure financial cycles (e.g., month-end close).
API literacy
Demonstrated problem-solving skills and creative thinking
Strong communication and presentation skills
Ability to work independently and collaborate with cross-functional teams
